detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the femoral articular process of the mesotrochanter and inserts into the trochanteral fossa of the mesofemur.

relationships.target_name: femoral articular process of the mesotrochanter

detailed.name: femoral condyle of the protibia
detailed.def: The femoral condyle of the tibia that is located on the protibia.

detailed.name: femoral condyle of the protrochanter
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the femoral articular process of the protrochanter and inserts into the trochanteral fossa of the profemur.

detailed.name: femoral condyle of the tibia
detailed.def: The condyle that is located proximally on the tibia and inserts into the tibial fossa of the femur.

detailed.name: femoral depression
detailed.comment: Concept miss-interpreted based on label only, interpretation doesn't exist in real life.

detailed.name: femoral fossa of the metatrochanter
detailed.def: The fossa that is located posteromedially on the metatrochanter and accommodates the trochanteral condyle of the metafemur.

detailed.name: femoral groove
detailed.def: The scrobe that is located on the mesopleuron into which the mesofemur fits when pressed against the mesosoma.

detailed.name: femoro-tibial joint
detailed.def: The dicondylic joint that is composed of the femur and the tibia.

detailed.name: femur
detailed.def: The leg segment that is distal to the trochanter and proximal to the tibia.

detailed.name: fibula ducti
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located in the proximal end of the unpaired part of the ductus ejaculatorius.

detailed.name: fifth flagellomere
detailed.def: The flagellomere that is located immediately distal to the fourth flagellomere.

detailed.name: fifth sclerite of the maxillary palp
detailed.def: The sclerite that is ringlike and is connected distally to the fourth sclerite of the maxillary palp via conjunctiva.

detailed.name: fifth tarsomere
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is distal to the fourth tarsomere.

detailed.name: fifth tarsomere of hind leg
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is distal to the fourth tarsomere of the hind leg.

detailed.name: fifth tarsomere of the fore leg
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is distal to the fouth tarsomere of the fore leg.

detailed.name: fifth tarsomere of the mid leg
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is distal to the fourth tarsomere of the mid leg.

detailed.name: first abdominal spiracle
detailed.def: The abdominal spiracle that is the anteriormost in the body.

detailed.name: first abdominal tergal spiracle muscle
detailed.def: The spiracular muscle that inserts on the first abdominal tergal spiracle.

detailed.name: first axillary sclerite of the fore wing
detailed.def: The first axillary sclerite that articulates anteriorly and medially with the anterior notal wing process laterally with the second axillary sclerite, and posteriorly with the posterior notal wing process.

detailed.name: first axillary sclerite
detailed.def: The axillary sclerite that articulates with the mesonotum.

detailed.name: first flagellomere
detailed.def: The flagellomere that is proximally attached to the pedicel.

detailed.name: first intrinsic muscle of the labial palp
detailed.def: The muscle that arises from the first sclerite of the labial palp and inserts on the second sclerite of the labial palp.

relationships.target_name: first sclerite of the labial palp
second sclerite of the labial palp

detailed.name: first intrinsic muscle of the maxillary palp
detailed.def: The muscle that arises from the first sclerite of the maxillary palp and inserts on the second sclerite of the maxillary palp.

relationships.target_name: first sclerite of the maxillary palp
second sclerite of the maxillary palp

detailed.name: first median plate
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located between the second axillary and the distal arm of the third axillary at the base of the mediocubital field.

detailed.name: first mesopleuro-mesonotal muscle
detailed.def: The mesonotal muscle that arises ventrally from the mesopectus and inserts on the mesoscutum laterally of the notauli and medially of the parascutal carina.

detailed.name: first mesopleuro-third axillary sclerite of fore wing muscle
detailed.def: The fore wing third axillary muscle that arises anterodorsally from the mesopleuron.

synonyms.name: first mesopleuro-third axillary sclerite of fore wing

relationships.target_name: third axillary sclerite of the fore wing

detailed.name: first phragmo-postoccipital muscle
detailed.def: The postoccipital muscle that originates from the first phragma and inserts on the postocciput.

detailed.name: first phragmo-propleural muscle
detailed.def: The propleural muscle that arises medially from the prophragma and inserts on the posterodorsal margin of the propleuron.

detailed.name: first phragmo-second phragmal muscle
detailed.def: The mesophragmal muscle that extends between the prophragma and mesophragma.

detailed.name: first sclerite of the labial palp
detailed.def: The sclerite that is ringlike and is connected distolaterally to the prementum via conjunctiva and muscle.

detailed.name: first sclerite of the maxillary palp
detailed.def: The sclerite that is ringlike and is connected distolaterally to the posterior stipital sclerite via conjunctiva and muscle.

detailed.name: first subdiscal
detailed.def: The wing cell that is located on the wing.

detailed.name: first valvifer
detailed.def: The area of the first valvifer-first valvula complex that is proximal to the aulax, bears the ninth tergal condyle of the first valvifer and the second valviferal condyle of the first valvifer and is connected to the genital membrane by muscle.

detailed.name: first valvifer-first valvula complex
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the sclerites that articulate with the ninth abdominal tergite and the second valvifer.

detailed.name: first valvifer-genital membrane muscle
detailed.def: The ovipositor muscle that arises from the posterior part of the first valvifer and inserts anteriorly on the genital membrane anetrior to the T9-genital membrane muscle.

detailed.name: first valvifer-second valvifer muscle
detailed.def: The ovipositor muscle that arises from the interarticular ridge of the first valvifer and inserts on the second valvifer.

detailed.name: first valviferal fossa of the ninth tergite
detailed.def: The fossa of the ninth abdominal tergite that is adjacent to the condyle of the ninth tergal condyle of the first valvifer.

detailed.name: first valvula
detailed.def: The area of the first valvifer-first valvula complex that is delimited distally by the proximal margin of the aulax.

detailed.name: fissure
detailed.def: The line that secondarily divides a sclerite.

detailed.name: flabellum
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located at the apex of the glossa in Apoidea.

detailed.name: flagellar scrobe of scape
detailed.def: The scrobe on the ventral region of the scape that accommodates the flagellum when it is pressed against the scape.

detailed.name: flagellomere
detailed.def: The annulus that is located distally of the pedicel.

detailed.name: flagellomere 14
detailed.def: The flagellomere that is located immediately distal to flagellomere 13.

detailed.name: flagellum
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster composed of flagellomeres.

detailed.name: flange
detailed.def: The projection that is lamella-like and is located on a rim, carina, apodeme or edge.

detailed.name: flexor apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located dorsally on the anterior margin of the metapectal-propodeal complex and corresponds to the site of origin of the metapleuro-third axillary sclerite of the hind wing muscle.

detailed.name: flexor of the pretarsal claws of the fore leg
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises from the profemoro-protibial joint and inserts on the unguitractor plate of the protarsus.

detailed.name: flexor of the pretarsal claws of the hind leg
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises from the metafemoro-metatibial joint and inserts on the unguitractor plate of the metatarsus.

detailed.name: flexor of the pretarsal claws of the middle leg
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises from the mesofemoro-mesotibial joint and inserts on the unguitractor plate of the mesotarsus.

detailed.name: foramen
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is surrounded by sclerites and allows for the passage of haemolymph, nerves and tracheae.

detailed.name: foramen genitale
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is surrounded by the proximal margin of the cupula.

detailed.name: fore leg
detailed.def: The leg that is located on the prothorax.

detailed.name: fore tibia
detailed.def: The tibia that is located on the fore leg.

detailed.name: fore wing
detailed.def: The wing that is located on the mesothorax.

detailed.name: fore wing base
detailed.def: The wing base that is located in the mesothorax.

detailed.name: fore wing blade
detailed.def: The wing blade that is located in the fore wing.

detailed.name: fore wing tegula
detailed.def: The cuticular evagination that is located laterally of the preaxilla and obscures the anterior mesonoto-first axillary articulation and the mesopleuro-second axillary sclerite joints.

detailed.name: fore wing third axillary muscle
detailed.def: The thoracic muscle that inserts on the third axillary sclerite of the fore wing.

detailed.name: fore wing vein
detailed.def: The wing vein that is on the fore wing.

detailed.name: fore wing venation
detailed.def: The venation of the fore wing.

detailed.name: foretarsal rake
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of longitudinal rows of spurs extending along the tarsomeres of the protarsus and are continuous with the row of spur of the preceeding and/or subsequent tarsomeres.

detailed.name: fossa
detailed.def: The articular surface that is concave and accommodates the condyle of another sclerite.

detailed.name: fourth flagellomere
detailed.def: The flagellomere that is located immediately distal to the third flagellomere.

detailed.name: fourth intrinsic muscle of the maxillary palp
detailed.def: The muscle that arises from the third sclerite of the maxillary palp and inserts on the fourth sclerite of the maxillary palp.

relationships.target_name: third sclerite of the maxillary palp
fourth sclerite of the maxillary palp

detailed.name: fourth sclerite of the maxillary palp
detailed.def: The sclerite that is ringlike and is connected distally to the third sclerite of the maxillary palp via conjunctiva.

detailed.name: fourth tarsomere
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is distal to and connected to the third tarsomere.

detailed.name: fourth tarsomere of hind leg
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is distal to and connected to the third tarsomere of the hind leg.

detailed.name: fourth tarsomere of mid leg
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is distal to and connected to the third tarsomere of the mid leg.

detailed.name: fourth tarsomere of the fore leg
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is distal to and connected to the third tarsomere of the fore leg.

detailed.name: fragmental articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the cardinal condyle of the lorum and the loral fossal of the cardo.

detailed.name: frenal carina
detailed.def: The frenal line that is a carina.

detailed.name: frenal line
detailed.def: The line that is transverse, arched anteriorly and is continuous with the posterior margins of the mesoscutellar arms.

detailed.name: frenal sulcus
detailed.def: The frenal line that is a sulcus.

detailed.name: frenum
detailed.def: The area that is located posteriorly on the mesoscutellum and is delimited anteriorly by the frenal line.

detailed.name: frons
detailed.def: The area that is between the epistomal line and the anterior ocellus and limited laterally by the inner margin of compound eye.

detailed.name: frontal carina
detailed.comment: Historically duplicated HAO in mx from pre-sensu model.

detailed.name: frontal carina line
detailed.def: The transverse torular line that extends between the frontal carinae.

detailed.name: frontal ledge
detailed.def: The edge that traverses the upper face between the antennal foramen and the median ocellus separating a more horizontal dorsal and a more vertical ventral area.

detailed.name: frontal line
detailed.def: The line that is median and extending on the frons.

detailed.name: frontal lobe
detailed.def: The flange that is located on the frontal carina and obscures the antennal foramen.

detailed.name: frontal orbit
detailed.def: The area that extends along the lateral margin of the upper face.

detailed.name: frontal patch
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is located on the frons.

detailed.name: frontal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that is transverse and extends just ventrally of the median ocellus and is never connected to the scrobal sulcus or depression or interantennal area.

detailed.name: frontal suture
detailed.def: The suture that diverges ventrally (or anteriorly) from the coronal suture between the antennal foramina toward the anterior articulations of the mandibles.

detailed.name: frontal triangle
detailed.def: The area that is located between the epistomal sulcus and the frontal line .

detailed.name: frontofacial ridge
detailed.def: The line that delimits dorsally the scrobal depression.

detailed.name: frontofacial sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that is transverse, located on the upper face and medially joining or intersecting the scrobal sulcus and interantennal area.

detailed.name: frontovertex
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the vertex and the dorsal area of the upper face dorsal to the frontofacial ridge.

detailed.name: functional mouth
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is delimited posteriorly by the distal part of the sitophore and anteriorly by the tormae.

detailed.name: funicle
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of flagellomeres located between the pedicel and clava or the distalmost anellus and clava.

detailed.name: funicle segment
detailed.def: The annulus that is located in the funicle.

detailed.name: funicular segment
detailed.def: The flagellomere that is located in the funicle.

detailed.name: furca
detailed.def: The apodeme that arises medially from the ventral part of the thorax and corresponds to the site of origin of interfurcal and coxal muscles.

detailed.name: furcal arm
detailed.def: The furca that is paired, arises medioventrally from the sternum and corresponds to the furcal pit.

detailed.name: furcal pit
detailed.def: The pit that corresponds to the furca.

detailed.name: furcasternum
detailed.def: The area that is located posteriorly on the prosternum and bears the profurca.

detailed.name: furcula
detailed.def: The sclerite that is proximal to the second valvifer and receives the site of origin of the posterior second valvifer-second valvula muscle.

detailed.translation: (沟; 凹槽; 刻痕; 缝)

detailed.name: gaine
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster composed of the second valvifer and the third valvula.

detailed.name: galea
detailed.def: The lobe that is located on the stipes at the distal part of the posterior stipital sclerite distolateral to the lacinia.

detailed.name: galeal comb
detailed.def: The galeal fringe that is on the lateral margin of the apicolateral galeal plate.

detailed.name: galeal crown
detailed.def: The galeal fringe that extends along the distal margin of the distal galeal plate.

detailed.name: galeal fringe
detailed.def: The row of setae that extends along the margin of the galeo-lacinial complex, distal to the lacinial lobe.

detailed.name: galeal lamina
detailed.def: The lobe that is located medially on the internal wall of the galeo-lacinial complex and margined by the galeal comb.

detailed.name: galeal midrib
detailed.def: The carina that extends medially along the medial wall of the galeo-lacinial complex and that is longitudinal.

detailed.name: galeo-lacinial complex
detailed.def: The area of the stipes that is delimited proximomedially by the stipito-premental conjunctiva, proximolaterally by the stipito-mandibular conjunctiva and posteroproximally by the margin of the posterior stipital sclerite.

detailed.name: gaster
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of all abdominal segments posterior to abdominal segment 2.

detailed.name: gastral scrobe
detailed.def: The scrobe that is located ventrally of the propodeal foramen and accommodates the gaster.

detailed.name: gastral spiracles
detailed.def: The spiracle that is located on the gaster.

detailed.name: gastral sternum
detailed.def: The strenum that is located in the gaster.

detailed.name: gastral tail
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the ovipositor and the distalmost abdominal tergum or the ovipositor and the distalmost abdominal tergum and the preceeding abdominal tergum.

detailed.name: gastral tergite
detailed.def: The tergite that is located on the gaster.

detailed.name: gastral tergum
detailed.def: The tergum that is located in the gaster.

detailed.name: gastrocoelus
detailed.def: The area that is concave, transverse, and located anterolaterally on abdominal tergum 3.

detailed.name: gena
detailed.def: The area that is delimited by the intersection of the interorbital plane, the margin of the compound eye, the margin of the oral foramen, the occipital carina and the malar sulcus.

detailed.name: gena contour line
detailed.def: The contour line of the gena area in frontal view.

detailed.name: genal carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends on the gena from the lateral margin of the oral foramen.

detailed.name: genal patch
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is located on the gena.

detailed.name: genal pilosity
detailed.def: The pilosity that is located on the gena.

detailed.name: genal space
detailed.def: The area that is located between the genal carina and the posterior margin of the compound eye, bounded ventrally by the malar sulcus and dorsally by the vertex.

detailed.name: genital membrane
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that connects the ventral margins of the second valvifers arching above the second valvula.

detailed.name: genitalia
detailed.def: The anatomical system that is involved in copulation, fertilization and/or oviposition.

detailed.name: genuflexor apodeme
detailed.def: The cuticular invagination at the distal end of the genuflexor sclerite that is adjacent to (articulates with) the outerwall of the tibia.

detailed.name: genuflexor plate
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located posteriorly along the proximal margin of the tibia and corresponds to the site of insertion of the medial femoro-tibial muscle.

detailed.name: genuflexor plate of the fore leg
detailed.def: The genuflexor plate that is located in the fore leg.

detailed.name: genuflexor plate of the hind leg
detailed.def: The genuflexor plate that is located in the hind leg.

detailed.name: genuflexor plate of the mid leg
detailed.def: The genuflexor plate that is located in the mid leg.

detailed.name: gland
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of epithelial cell(s) that secrete or excrete materials not related to their ordinary metabolic needs.

detailed.name: glandular release pit of the scutellum
detailed.def: The area that is concave is located medially on the scutellar plate and corresponds to the opening of an exocrine gland.

detailed.name: glossa
detailed.def: The lobe of the labium that is limited posteroproximally by the prementum, anteroproximally by the fold traversing the salivary orifice and laterally by the paraglossae.

detailed.name: glossal annulus
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster of the glossa that is composed of connected annular hairs.

detailed.name: glossal styloconic sensillum
detailed.def: The styloconic sensillum that is located apically on the glossa.

detailed.name: glymma
detailed.def: The groove that is located between the spiracle and the anterior margin of abdominal tergum 2.

detailed.name: gonad
detailed.def: The compound organ that makes gametes.

detailed.name: gonochoristic organism
detailed.def: Multi-cellular organism that has male and female sexes.

detailed.name: gonocondyle
detailed.def: The apophysis that is located ventromedially on the proximal margin of the cupula and is the site of insertion of the lateral S9-cupulal muscle.

detailed.name: gonoforceps
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located distally of the cupula and dorsolaterally of the volsella, surrounds the aedeagus dorsolaterally and does not connected to any sclerite distally.

detailed.name: gonomacula
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that is located at the distal apex of the harpe.

detailed.name: gonopod
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the gonostipites, volsellae and harpes.

detailed.name: gonossiculal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that inserts on the gonossiculus.

detailed.name: gonossiculo-phallotremal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises from the basiura and inserts on the endophallus.

detailed.name: gonossiculus
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the distoventral part of the gonostyle/volsella complex, and is articulated with the more proximal sclerites of the gononstyle/volsella complex.

detailed.name: gonostipes
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located dorsolaterally on the gonostyle/volsella complex, is connected to the distal margin of the cupula, to the proximal margin of the harpe, and to the lateral margin of the volsella.

detailed.name: gonostipes/volsella complex
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is part of the gonostyle/volsella complex and is composed of the sclerites that are proximal to the harpe.

detailed.name: gonostipital arm
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located proximally on the ventral part of the gonostipes.

detailed.name: gonostipo-volsellal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises proximally from the ventral part of the gonostipes and inserts on the volsella at the border between the gono- and parossiculi.

detailed.name: gonostyle
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of sclerites located distally of the cupula dorsolaterally of the volsella, and that surround the aedeagus.

synonyms.name: outer or central arm of stipes

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the sclerites that are located distally of the cupula and surround the aedeagus.

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex-gonossiculus articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the parossiculal articular surface of the gonossiculus and the gonossiculal articular surface of the parossiculus.

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex-gonossiculus muscle
detailed.def: The gonossiculal muscle that arises ventromedially from the gonostyle/volsella complex and inserts laterally on the gonossiculus.

synonyms.name: medial intrinsic muscle of the volsella

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex-harpal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises from the gonostyle/volsella complex and inserts on the harpe.

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex-parossiculal muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that arises ventromedially from the gonostyle, is proximomedially oriented, and inserts on the proximalmost sclerite of the volsella.

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex-penisvalval muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises from the gonostyle/volsella complex and inserts on the penisvalva.

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex-volsellal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises proximoventrally from the gonostyle/volsella complex and inserts nearby the gonossiculal articulation.

detailed.name: gorgeret
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster composed of the second valvifer, second valvula, and third valvula.

detailed.name: gradulus
detailed.def: The carina that is transverse and posteriorly directed laterally and is located on the abdominal tergite.

detailed.name: groove
detailed.def: The line that is located on the sclerite and is impressed.

detailed.name: gular ridge
detailed.comment: There is no gula in Hymenoptera.

detailed.name: gular sulcus
detailed.comment: There is no gula in Hymenoptera.

detailed.name: hairless streak
detailed.def: A bare region of the forewing immediately beyond the basal setal line behind the parastigma.

detailed.name: hairy lobe
detailed.def: The process that is setiferous and is located on the ventral margin of the second valvula and corresponds with one of the subdivisions of the second valvula.

detailed.name: hairy ring of T3
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is extending along the third metasomal tergum.

detailed.name: hairy ring of the metasoma
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that extends along the second metasomal tergum.

detailed.name: hamulus
detailed.def: The seta that is located on the anterior margin of the hind wing and interlocks with the recurved posterior edge of the fore wing in Hymenoptera during flight, making them functionally one winged.

detailed.name: harpe
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located distally on the gonostyle/volsella complex and does not connect to the cupula, and does not connect to the volsella by conjunctiva or muscles.

detailed.name: harpe length
detailed.def: The anatomical line between the distalmost point of the gonostyle volsella complex and the distalmost point of the harpe in lateral view.

detailed.name: harpe width
detailed.def: The width of the harpe in lateral view.

detailed.name: harpo-gonomaculal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises form the harpe and inserts on the gonomacula.

detailed.name: head
detailed.def: The tagma that is located anterior to the thorax.

detailed.name: head capsule
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the cranium and compound eye cuticle.

detailed.name: head height
detailed.def: The median anatomical line of the head in anterior view.

detailed.name: head length
detailed.def: The median anatomical line of the head in dorsal view.

detailed.name: head muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that is located in the head.

detailed.name: head width
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the longest horizontal diameter of the cranium in frontal view.

detailed.name: hermaphroditic organism
detailed.def: Multi-cellular organism that can produce both male and female gametes.

detailed.name: hind leg
detailed.def: The leg that is located on the metathorax.

detailed.name: hind wing
detailed.def: The wing that is located on the metathorax.

detailed.name: hind wing base
detailed.def: The wing base that is located in the hind wing.

detailed.name: hind wing tegula
detailed.def: The tegula of the hind wing.

detailed.name: hind wing third axillary muscle
detailed.def: The thoracic muscle that inserts on the third axillary sclerite of the hind wing.

detailed.name: horizontal plate
detailed.def: The flange that extends dorsolaterally from the mesodiscrimenal lamella.

synonyms.name: horizontal plate of the mesosternal apophysis

detailed.name: horn of T1
detailed.def: The area that is located anteriorly on mediotergum 1, is raised and contains the proximal part of the retracted ovipositor

detailed.name: humeral complex of the fore wing
detailed.def: The humeral complex that is located on the fore wing.

detailed.name: humeral plate
detailed.def: The sclerite that articulates with the proximal end of the costal vein.

detailed.name: humeral sclerite of the metanotum
detailed.def: The sclerite that is connected to the lateral margin of the metanotum and bears the anterior metanotal wing process.

detailed.name: hyaline break
detailed.def: The costal notch that is on the submarginal vein near the parastigma.

detailed.name: hymenopteran
detailed.def: The multi-cellular organism that is classified in Hymenoptera.

detailed.name: hyperoccipital carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends on the vertex between the outer orbits.

detailed.name: hypochaeta
detailed.def: The mechanosensory hair that projects backward from the anterior margin of the ventral surface of the forewing.

detailed.name: hypoclypeal depression
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is delimited anteriorly by the clypeus and posteriorly by the labrum.

detailed.name: hypopharyngeal button
detailed.def: The bent area of the hypopharyngeal rod that receives the site of insertion of the posterior tentorio-premental muscle.

detailed.name: hypopharyngeal lobe
detailed.def: The lobe that is situated distally of the sitophore and proximally of the infrabuccal pouch.

detailed.name: hypopharyngeal muscle
detailed.def: The head muscle that inserts on the hypopharyngeal wall.

detailed.name: hypopharyngeal pecten
detailed.def: The anterolateral area of the distal hypopharynx that is adjacent with the proximal part of the hypopharyngeal rod proximal to the hypopharyngeal button and is covered with acanthae.

detailed.name: hypopharyngeal rod
detailed.def: The ligament that connects the proximolateral margin of the prementum with the proximal part of the ligula.

detailed.name: hypopharynx
detailed.def: The area that is delimited proximally by the proximal margin of the sitophore, distally by the salivarial orifice.

detailed.name: hypoproct
detailed.def: The area that is located in between the anal opening and the genitalia.

detailed.name: hypopygium
detailed.def: The abdominal sternum that is the posteriormost visible sclerite located ventrally in the abdomen.

detailed.name: hypostoma
detailed.def: The area that extends on the posterior (ventral) margin of the oral foramen along the site of attachments of the conjunctiva connecting the cranium with the maxillae and is delimited laterally by the pleurostomal fossa.

detailed.name: hypostomal bridge
detailed.def: The subforaminal bridge that is delimited laterally by the dorsally extended hypostomal carina.

detailed.name: hypostomal carina
detailed.def: The carina that delimits the hypostoma from the cranium.

detailed.name: hypostomal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends along the posteroventral margin of the cranium between the pleurostomal fossae and delimits the hypostoma.

detailed.name: hypostomal tooth
detailed.def: The projection that is located on the posterolateral margin of the oral foramen at the junction of the hypostoma and the pleurostomal fossa.

detailed.name: immaterial anatomical entity
detailed.def: Anatomical entity that has no mass.

detailed.name: impression
detailed.def: The groove that does not correspond to a ridge.

detailed.name: inferior pronotal spine
detailed.def: The spine that is located laterally on the anterior margin of the pronotum.

detailed.name: inflection
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of a ridge that extends along the margin of a sclerite and the marginal area of the sclerite delimited from the sclerite by the ridge articulating with the inflection of another sclerite.

detailed.name: infrabuccal pouch
detailed.def: The pouch that is situated on the hypopharyngeal wall distally of the sitophore.

detailed.name: inner cardinal process
detailed.def: The articular process that is located distomedially on the cardo and articulates with the stipes.

detailed.name: inner lobe of the lacinia
detailed.def: The lacinial lobe that is medial to the outer lobe of the lacinia.

detailed.name: inner orbit
detailed.def: The line that extends along the border between the eye and face.

detailed.name: inner spur
detailed.def: The mesotibial spur that is located anteriorly on the distal margin of the mesotibia.

detailed.name: integrated tarsal plantula
detailed.def: The tarsal plantula that arises medially on the tarsomere.

detailed.name: integument
detailed.def: The anatomical system that forms the covering layer of the animal, ectodermal in origin and composed of epidermal cells producing the cuticle.

detailed.name: interantennal area
detailed.def: The area that is delimited dorsally by the antennal scrobes.

detailed.name: interarticular ridge of the first valvifer
detailed.def: The ridge that extends along the posterior margin of the first valvifer between the intervalvifer and tergovalvifer articulations.

detailed.name: interaxillar sulcus
detailed.def: The median sulcus of the mesonotum between the anterior margin of the mesoscutellar-axillar complex and the anterior margin of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: intercardinal area
detailed.def: The area that is located between the cardines and limited proximally and distally by the anatomical line that extends between the proximal and distal ends of the left and right cardines.

detailed.name: intercardinal sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite on the intercardinal area that is not paired.

detailed.name: intercoxal space
detailed.def: The area that is located between the acetabular carina and the ventral mesopleural carina.

detailed.name: intermalar distance
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the longest horizontal diameter (major axis) of the oral foramen.

detailed.name: internal male genitalia
detailed.def: The compound organ that functions as producer and transporter of sperm, spermatophore and semen, composed of the testes, vas deferens, accessory glands and ductus ejaculatorius. Ecto- and mesodermal in origin.

detailed.name: internal median longitudinal scutoscutellar ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that is median and is at the posterior region of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: internal metanotal ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that corresponds to the metascutellar arm.

detailed.name: internal protrusion
detailed.def: The rim that extends along the distal margin of the ventral femoral wall.

detailed.name: internal septum
detailed.def: The flange that extends along the margin of the mesoscutellum reducing its opening into the lumen of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: interocellar pit
detailed.def: The pit that is located on the upper face between lateral ocelli and corresponds internally with a conical apodeme and not the tentorium.

detailed.name: interocellar space
detailed.def: The area that is limited posteriorly by the posterior ocellar line and laterally by the lateral ocellar line.

detailed.name: interocular distance
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is perpendicular to the anteroposterior body axis and extends between the medial margins of the compound eyes.

detailed.name: interocular separation
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the shortest between the compound eyes on the vertex.

detailed.name: interommatidial seta
detailed.def: The seta that is located at the intersection of the margins of three ommatidiae.

detailed.name: interorbital plane
detailed.def: The area that is defined by the anatomical lines that are tangent to a point at the minimal distance from the eyes to the lateral ocelli.

detailed.name: interorbital space
detailed.def: The interocular distance that is the shortest between the inner margin of compound eyes.

detailed.name: interpenisvalval muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that connects the valvurae.

detailed.name: interscrobal surface
detailed.def: The area that is limited laterally by the antennal scrobes.

detailed.name: intersegmental membrane
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that connects two segments.

detailed.name: intersegmental membrane-mesobasalar muscle
detailed.def: The mesobasalar muscle that arises from the intersegmental membrane between the pronotum and the mesopectus and inserts on the mesobasalare.

detailed.name: intersegmentalia
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the intersegmental membrane.

detailed.name: intersternite
detailed.def: The intersegmentalia that is located in between sterna.

detailed.name: interstice
detailed.def: The area that is unsculptured and is delimited by striae or punctures.

detailed.name: interstipital area
detailed.def: The area of the postmental area that is limited laterally by the median margins of the stipites, proximally by the anterior margin of the intercardinal area and distally by the proximal margin of the prementum.

detailed.name: interstipital sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the interstipital area and is connected to the prementum via conjunctiva.

detailed.name: intertarsomeral joint
detailed.def: The monocondylic joint that is composed of two tarsomeres.

detailed.name: intertegular distance
detailed.def: The anatomical line that connects the inner margins of the right and left tegula.

detailed.name: intertergal extensor muscle
detailed.def: The abdominal muscle that attaches to the tergal apodeme of the abdominal tergite and attaches posterior to the antecostal ridge of the subsequent tergite.

detailed.name: intertergal suture
detailed.def: The line of separation that is located between consecutive abdominal terga.

detailed.name: intertorular area
detailed.def: The median area of the face between the dorsal (posterior) margin of the clypeus and the intertolural carina.

detailed.name: intertorular carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends between the dorsal margin of the antennal rims.

detailed.name: intervalvifer articulation
detailed.def: The articulation between the first valvifer and second valvifer.

detailed.name: intervalvula
detailed.def: The sternal sclerite in the venter of the ninth abdominal segment between the second valvifers.

detailed.name: intervolsellal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that connects the proximal part of parossiculi.

detailed.name: intervolsellar process
detailed.def: The projection that is located distomedially on the parossiculus and is continuous with the volsellar ridge.

detailed.name: intragonostyle muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that connects the ventral and dorsal walls of the gonostyle basally.

detailed.name: intravalvifer articulation
detailed.def: The articulation between the dorsal sclerite of the first valvifer and the ventral sclerite of the first valvifer.

detailed.name: intrinsic leg muscle
detailed.def: The leg muscle that inserts and originates in the leg.

detailed.name: intrinsic maxillary palp muscle
detailed.def: The maxillar muscle that connects two maxillary sclerites.

detailed.name: intrinsic muscle of the 9th sternum
detailed.def: The sternal muscle that connects the lateral margins of the abdominal tergum 9 and extends internally of the external male genitalia.

detailed.name: intrinsic muscle of the gonostipes
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that connects the dorsal and ventral part of the gonostipes.

detailed.name: intrinsic muscle of the harpe
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises from the proximal margin of the lateral surface of the harpe and inserts proximally on the median surface of the harpe.

detailed.name: intrinsic muscle of the mesopleuron
detailed.def: The mesopleural muscle that arises from the mesopleuron.

detailed.name: intrinsic muscle of the metapleuron
detailed.def: The metapleural muscle that arises from the metapleuron.

detailed.name: intrinsic muscle of the propleuron
detailed.def: The propleural muscle that arises from the propleuron.

detailed.name: intrinsic palpal muscle
detailed.def: The labial muscle that arises from a palpal sclerite and inserts on the palpal sclerite distal to it.

detailed.name: joint
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of two sclerites connected by at least one articulation and the articular membrane located connecting the two sclerite.

detailed.name: jugal region
detailed.def: The wing region that is delimited by the plica jugalis.

detailed.name: juxtantennal carina
detailed.def: The carina that is longitudinal and mesal to the antennal base.

detailed.name: kleisiades
detailed.def: The area that is located apically on the gonostyle when it consist only from one sclerite and set off partly by conjunctiva. The kleisiades is never connected to the proximal part of the gonostyle via muscles.

detailed.name: knee
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that consists of the distal part of the femur and the proximal part of the tibia.

detailed.name: labial endite
detailed.comment: Adds an unnecessary layer in the circumscription of glossa and paraglossa

detailed.name: labial gland
detailed.def: The gland that empties between the base of the hypopharynx and the labium, or on the hypopharynx.

detailed.name: labial muscle
detailed.def: The head muscle that inserts on the labium.

detailed.name: labial palp
detailed.def: The anatomical structure that is distal to the proximal margin of the first sclerite of the labial palp.

detailed.name: labial palpal excision
detailed.def: The notch that is located distolaterally on the prementum and receives the base of the labial palp.

detailed.name: labial palpomere
detailed.def: The sclerite that is part of the labial palp.

detailed.name: labial suture
detailed.comment: The concept is misunderstood in this definition. For labial suture see HAO_0002147.

detailed.name: labio-hypopharyngeal lobe
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the labium and the hypopharynx.

detailed.name: labiomaxillary complex
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the labium and maxillae.

detailed.name: labium
detailed.def: The appendage that is encircled by the area that is proximally delimited by the lateral margins of the cardo and the posterior stipital sclerite laterally, and the anatomical line that is tangential to the salivary duct and traverses the salivary orifice anteriorly.

detailed.name: labral apodeme
detailed.def: The tendon that connects the fronto-labral muscle with the lateral margin of the labrum.

detailed.name: labral compressor
detailed.def: The epipharyngeal muscle that arises from the proximal part of the labrum and inserts on the distal epipharyngeal wall.

detailed.name: labral digit
detailed.def: The styloconic sensilla on the apical margin of the labrum.

detailed.name: labral muscle
detailed.def: The head muscle that inserts on the labrum.

detailed.name: labral seta
detailed.def: The seta that is located on the labrum.

detailed.name: labrum
detailed.def: The sclerite that is situated along the distal margin of the clypeus and is connected along its proximal margin with the distal margin of the epipharyngeal wall.

detailed.name: lacinial bar
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the lateral wall of the lacinial lobe.

detailed.name: lacinial comb
detailed.def: The row of setae on the lacinial lobe that is marginal.

detailed.name: lacinial lobe
detailed.def: The lobe that extends proximally on the distal margin of the medial stipital wall, is adjacent to the basal lacinial sclerite, overlaps the proximal part of the galea.

detailed.name: laminated bridge
detailed.def: The area that is located proximally on the notal membrane near the processus articularis is sclerotised and is continuous with the second valvulae.

detailed.name: lamnium
detailed.def: The area that is located on the lateral wall of the first and second valvulae and is subdivided by annuli.

detailed.name: lanze
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the first valvifer and the first valvula.

detailed.name: large disc sensilla
detailed.def: The row of sensilla whose cuticular component are flat, circular and lack a median peg.

detailed.name: large volcano sensilla
detailed.def: The sensillum with a distal, volcano-shape cuticular component on the apical-most flagellomere.

detailed.name: larval abdomen
detailed.def: The larval tagma that is located posterior to the thorax.

detailed.name: larval head
detailed.def: The larval tagma that is located anterior to the thorax.

detailed.name: larval tagma
detailed.def: The tagma that is located in the larva.

detailed.name: larval thorax
detailed.def: The larval tagma that is composed of the prothorax, mesothorax and metathorax and is located between the head and the abdomen.

detailed.name: lateral S9-cupulal muscle
detailed.def: The S9-cupulal muscle that arises sublaterally from S9 and inserts medioventrally on the cupula.

detailed.name: lateral T8-T9 muscle
detailed.def: The ninth abdominal tergal muscle that arises from the anterolateral margin of female T8 and inserts on the anterolateral margin of female T9.

detailed.name: lateral T9-second valvifer muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that arises from the posteroventral parts of the female T9 and inserts on the median bridge.

detailed.name: lateral antecostal projection
detailed.def: The projection that extends over the lateral portion of the antecostal sulcus.

detailed.name: lateral apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located laterally on the proximal margin of abdominal tergum 9.

detailed.name: lateral area of the mesoscutum
detailed.def: The area that is located between the notaulus and the parascutal carina.

detailed.name: lateral articular process
detailed.def: The projection that is located on the prolpeuron posterolaterally of the epicoxal lobe and bears the procoxal condyle of the propleuron.

synonyms.name: lateral coxal articular process of the propleuron

detailed.name: lateral axillar area
detailed.def: The area that is located laterally on the axilla and is delimited medially by the axillar carina.

detailed.name: lateral bar of the mesoscutellum
detailed.def: The bar that extends from the dorsal axillar area to the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: lateral basisternal projection
detailed.def: The area that is located anterolaterally on the basisternum and forms the median propleural site of articulation with the procoxa.

detailed.name: lateral cardinal cavity
detailed.def: The area that is limited medially by the laterodistal and basal cardinal ridges.

detailed.name: lateral carina of abdominal tergite 3
detailed.def: The carina that extends along the lateral margin of abdominal tergite 3.

detailed.name: lateral carina of clypeus
detailed.def: The carina that extends between the ventral (anterior) margin of the antennal foramen to the apical clypeal margin.

detailed.name: lateral carina of the gastral scrobe
detailed.def: The carina that delimits laterally the gastral scrobe.

detailed.name: lateral clypeal seta
detailed.def: The seta that is located laterally on the clypeus.

detailed.name: lateral coxal articular process of the mesopleuron
detailed.def: The articular process that is located ventrolaterally on the mesopleuron and bears the lateral coxal condyle of the mesopleuron.

detailed.name: lateral coxal articular process of the metapleuron
detailed.def: The articular process that is located on the lateroventral margin of the metapectus and bears the lateral coxal condyle of the metapleuron.

detailed.name: lateral coxal condyle of the mesopleuron
detailed.def: The lateral coxal condyle of the pleuron that is located on the lateral coxal articular process of the mesopleuron and inserts into the lateral mesopectal fossa of the mesocoxa.

is_a.name: lateral coxal condyle of the pleuron

relationships.target_name: lateral coxal articular process of the mesopleuron

detailed.name: lateral coxal condyle of the metapleuron
detailed.def: The lateral coxal condyle of the pleuron that is located on the lateral coxal articular process of the metapleuron and inserts into the lateral pectal fossa of the metacoxa.

is_a.name: lateral coxal condyle of the pleuron

relationships.target_name: lateral coxal articular process of the metapleuron

detailed.name: lateral coxal condyle of the pleuron
detailed.def: The condyle that is located distally on the lateral coxal articular process of the pleuron and inserts into the lateral pectal fossa of the coxa.

detailed.name: lateral coxal condyle of the propleuron
detailed.def: The lateral coxal condyle of the pleuron that is located distally on the  lateral coxal articular process of the propleuron and inserts into the lateral pectal fossa of the procoxa.

is_a.name: lateral coxal condyle of the pleuron

detailed.name: lateral epomia
detailed.def: The area that is limited medially by the dorsal end of the epomial carina.

detailed.name: lateral eye height
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the longest vertical diameter of the compound eye in lateral view.

detailed.name: lateral flange of the principal carina of the stipes
detailed.def: The flange on the lateral part of the prinicipal carina of the stipes.

detailed.name: lateral fovea
detailed.def: The area that is located medially on the transverse pronotal sulcus and separates the pronotal plate from the anterior rim of pronotum.

detailed.name: lateral frontal septum
detailed.def: The ridge that is paired, vertical and extends submedially on the frons. The posterior fronto-labral muscles arises partly from the septum.

detailed.name: lateral galeal crease
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that is between the distolateral and proximolateral galeal sclerites.

detailed.name: lateral galeal sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located laterally on the lateral wall of the galeo-lacinial complex.

detailed.name: lateral gonostyle/volsella complex-penisvalval muscle
detailed.def: The gonostyle/volsella complex-penisvalval muscle that arises anterolaterally of the site of origin of the distodorsal gonostyle/volsella complex-penisvalval muscle and inserts laterally on the penisvalva.

detailed.name: lateral gonostyle/volsella complex-volsella muscle
detailed.def: The gonostyle/volsella complex-volsellal muscle that arises laterally of the submedian conjunctiva on the distoventral margin of gonostyle/volsella complex.

detailed.name: lateral head length
detailed.def: The anatomical line that connects the widest point between the apical edge of the compound eyes and extends to the anterior and posterior cranial margins in lateral view.

detailed.name: lateral incision of metanoum
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that is between the anterior and posterior metanotal wing processes.

detailed.name: lateral intertergal retractor muscle
detailed.def: The abdominal muscle that attaches to the tergal apodeme of an abdominal tergite and the antecosta of the subsequent tergite.

relationships.target_name: occlusor of the propodeal spiracle muscle

detailed.name: lateral longitudinal carina
detailed.def: The carina that is lateral, longitudinal and arises from the anterior margin of the propodeum and extends towards the petiolar foramen.

detailed.name: lateral longitudinal metepisternal carina
detailed.def: The carina that delimits laterally the metepisternal depression.

detailed.name: lateral margin of mesoscutum
detailed.def: The inflection that extends along the anterolateral margin of the mesoscutum and fit with the dorsal pronotal inflection.

detailed.name: lateral mesocoxo-mesotrochanteral muscle
detailed.def: The mesotrochanteral muscle that arises laterally from the mesocoxa and inserts anteriorly on the trochanter anterolaterally of the posterior mesocoxo-mesotrochanteral articulation.

synonyms.name: anterior levator of the middle trochanter

detailed.name: lateral mesofemoro-mesotibial muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises laterally (dorsally) of the mesofemur and inserts on the dorsal process of the mesotibia.

detailed.name: lateral mesofurcal arm
detailed.def: The apodeme that arises from the base of the mesofurca.

detailed.name: lateral mesofurco-mesotrochanteral muscle
detailed.def: The mesotrochanteral muscle that arises laterally from the lateral mesofurcal arm, laterally to the site of origin  of the median mesofurco-mesotrochanteral muscle and inserts on the mesotrochanteral apodeme.

detailed.name: lateral mesofurco-metafurcal muscle
detailed.def: The mesofurco-metafurcal muscle that inserts on the anterior metafurcal arm.

detailed.name: lateral mesophragmo-metaphragmal muscle
detailed.def: The mesophragmo-metaphragmal muscle that inserts laterally on the metaphragma.

detailed.name: lateral mesopleuro-mesocoxal articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the lateral coxal condyle of the mesopleuron and the lateral pectal fossa of the mesocoxa.

detailed.name: lateral mesoscutellar spine
detailed.def: The projection that is located on the posterodorsal margin of the axillula.

detailed.name: lateral mesosoma length
detailed.def: The anatomical line between the anteriormost point of the anterior rim of pronotum and the posterodorsal edge of the nucha in lateral view.

detailed.name: lateral metafemoro-metatibial muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises laterally from the metafemur and inserts on the dorsal process of the metatibia.

detailed.name: lateral metafurco-metacoxal muscle
detailed.def: The metafurco-metacoxal muscle that arises laterally from the metafurca.

detailed.name: lateral metapleuro-metabasalar muscle
detailed.def: The metapleuro-metabasalar muscle that arises from the metabasalar apodeme.

detailed.name: lateral metapleuro-metacoxal articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the lateral coxal condyle of the metapleuron and the lateral pectal fossa of the metacoxa.

detailed.name: lateral metapleuro-metacoxal muscle
detailed.def: The metacoxal muscle that originates ventrally of the metapleural ridge and inserts anterolaterally on the dorsal margin of the metacoxa.

detailed.name: lateral metapleuro-metanotal muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that arises laterally from the metapleuron and iserts on the muscle bearing process of the metanotum.

detailed.name: lateral metapleuro-second abdominal sternal muscle
detailed.def: The second abdominal sternal muscle that arises from the metapleuron.

detailed.name: lateral metatrochantero-metafemoral articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the femoral articular process of the metatrochanter and the trochanteral fossa of the metafemur.

detailed.name: lateral metepisternal projection
detailed.def: The projection that is located anteriorly on the lateral longitudinal metepisternal carina.

detailed.name: lateral neck plate
detailed.comment: There is no cervical sclerite and hence no cervix in Hymenoptera.

detailed.name: lateral occipital carina
detailed.def: The area that is located laterally on the occipital carina.

detailed.name: lateral ocellar line
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the shortest between the margins of the  median and lateral ocelli.

detailed.name: lateral ocellus
detailed.def: The ocellus that is paired.

detailed.name: lateral panel of pronotum
detailed.def: The area that is concave and is located ventrally of the level of the anterior thoracic spiracle.

detailed.name: lateral pectal fossa of the coxa
detailed.def: The fossa that is located laterally on the proximal margin of the coxa and accommodates the lateral coxal condyle of the pectus.

detailed.name: lateral pectal fossa of the mesocoxa
detailed.def: The the lateral pectal fossa of the coxa that is located laterally on the proximal margin of the mesocoxa and accommodates the lateral coxal condyle of the mesopleuron.

is_a.name: lateral pectal fossa of the coxa

detailed.name: lateral pectal fossa of the metacoxa
detailed.def: The lateral pectal fossa of the coxa that is located laterally on the proximal margin of the metacoxa and accommodates the lateral coxal articular process of the metapleuron.

is_a.name: lateral pectal fossa of the coxa

detailed.name: lateral pectal fossa of the procoxa
detailed.def: The lateral pectal fossa of the coxa that is located laterally on the probasicoxite and accommodates the lateral coxal condyle of the propleuron.

is_a.name: lateral pectal fossa of the coxa

detailed.name: lateral penisvalvo-gonossiculal muscle
detailed.def: The penisvalvo gonossiculal muscle that is lateral to the medial penisvalvo-gonossiculal muscle and attaches to the digiceps

detailed.name: lateral petiolar carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends laterally on the abdominal tergum 2 from the petiolar collar to the second abdominal spiracle laterally of the dorsope.

detailed.name: lateral premental face
detailed.def: The area of the prementum, that lays parallel and connected via conjunctiva to the medial stipital vall.

detailed.name: lateral profemoro-protibial muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises laterally (dorsally)  from the profemur and inserts laterally (dorsally) on the dorsal process of the protibia.

detailed.name: lateral projection
detailed.def: The corner that is located ventrolaterally on the ventral rim of clypeus.

detailed.name: lateral pronotal area
detailed.def: The area of the pronotum that is lateral and delimited medially by the epomial carina.

detailed.name: lateral pronoto-prophragmal muscle
detailed.def: The prophragmal muscle that arises laterally of the site of origin of the median pronoto-prophragmal and medially of the site of origin of the lateral pronoto-postoccipital muscles.

detailed.name: lateral propleural area
detailed.def: The area that is located laterally on the propleuron and is delimited by the longitudinal carina of the propleuron.

detailed.name: lateral propleuro-postoccipital muscle
detailed.def: The propleuro-postoccipital muscle that arises laterally from the propleuron.

detailed.name: lateral propleuro-procoxal articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the lateral coxal condyle of the propleuron and the lateral pectal articular fossa of the procoxa.

detailed.name: lateral propodeal area
detailed.def: The area that is located laterally on the propodeum, is delimited posteromedially by the lateral propodeal carina and is delimited laterally by the plica.

detailed.name: lateral propodeal carina
detailed.def: The carina that is oblique and arises submedially from the anterior margin of the metapectal-propodeal complex and extends to the posterior propodeal projection.

detailed.name: lateral scapo-pedicellar muscle
detailed.def: The antennal muscle that arises posteromedially on the proximal part of the scape and inserts laterally on the proximal part of the pedicel.

detailed.name: lateral scutellar keel
detailed.def: The carina which is present on the lateral margin of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: lateral scutellar pit
detailed.def: The pit that is located along the posterolateral margin of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: lateral suspensor of the mouth
detailed.def: The hypopharyngeal muscle that arises from the distal end of the anterior tentorial arm or from the inner surface of the head capsule and inserts on the lateral surface of the proximolateral processes of the sitophore.

detailed.name: lateral tentorio-scapal muscle
detailed.def: The antennal muscle that arises laterally from the proximal parts of the dorsal and anterior tentorial arms and is inserted posterolaterally on the proximal part of the scape.

detailed.name: latero-proximal stipital process
detailed.def: The projection that is on the proximolateral margin of the posterior stipital sclerite.

detailed.name: laterocervical muscle
detailed.def: The thoracic muscle that inserts on the laterocervicalia.

detailed.name: laterocervico-procoxal muscle
detailed.def: The procoxal muscle that arises from the cervical apodeme and inserts on the procoxa on the opposite side from which it arises.

detailed.name: laterodistal cardinal ridge
detailed.def: The cardinal ridge that arises distally from the basal cardinal ridge and is oriented distolaterally.

detailed.name: laterodorsal projection of mesoscutellum
detailed.def: The process that is located posterodorsally on the axillular carina.

detailed.name: laterope
detailed.def: The depression that is located laterally and proximally on abdominal tergum 2.

detailed.name: laterophragma
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located laterally on the postnotum.

detailed.name: laterosternal sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is between the procoxa and the prosternum.

detailed.name: laterosternite
detailed.def: The sternite that is located laterally on an abdominal sternum.

detailed.name: laterosternite 10
detailed.def: The laterosternite that is located on abdominal sternum 10.

detailed.name: laterosternite 2
detailed.def: The laterosternite that is located on abdominal sternum 2.

detailed.name: laterosternite 3
detailed.def: The laterosternite that is located on abdominal sternum 3.

detailed.name: laterosternite 4
detailed.def: The laterosternite that is located on abdominal sternum 4.

detailed.name: laterosternite 5
detailed.def: The laterosternite that is located on abdominal sternum 5.

detailed.name: laterosternite 6
detailed.def: The laterosternite that is located on abdominal sternum 6.

detailed.name: laterosternite 7
detailed.def: The laterosternite that is located on abdominal sternum 7.

detailed.name: laterosternite 8
detailed.def: The laterosternite that is located on abdominal sternum 8.

detailed.name: laterosternite 9
detailed.def: The laterosternite that is located on abdominal sternum 9.

detailed.name: laterotergite
detailed.def: The tergite that is located laterally on the abdominal tergum.

detailed.name: lateroventral carina of the petiole
detailed.def: The carina that is longitudinal and extends lateroventrally on the abdominal segment 2.

detailed.name: lateroventral mesopleural carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends lateroventrally on the mesopleuron between the lateral end of the epicnemium and the lateral margin of the mesocoxal foramen.

detailed.name: leg
detailed.def: The appendage that is composed of the coxa and all distal leg segments and is connected to the pectus.

detailed.name: leg muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that inserts on the leg.

detailed.name: leg segment
detailed.def: The segment that is part of a leg.

detailed.name: length of 1st flagellomere
detailed.def: The proximodistal anatomical line of the 1st flagellomere.

detailed.name: length of T1
detailed.def: The median anatomical line of the abdominal tergum 2.

detailed.name: length of anterior area of second valvifer
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is parallel with the longitudinal body axis and the shortest among the anatomical lines that extend between the anterior and posterior margins of the anterior area of the second valvifer.

detailed.name: length of dorsal projection
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is parallel with the longitudinal body axis and the shortest among the anatomical line that extends between the anterior and posterior margins of the dorsal projection of the second valvifer.

detailed.name: length of female T9
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is parallel with the longitudinal body axis and the shortest among the anatomical lines that extend between the anterior and posterior margins of female T9.

detailed.name: length of hypopygium
detailed.def: The median anatomical line of the hypopygium in ventral view.

detailed.name: length of malar sulcus
detailed.def: The straight anatomical line between the proximal and distal ends of the malar sulcus.

detailed.name: length of mesoscutellar-axillar complex
detailed.def: The median anatomical line of the mesoscutellar-axillar complex in dorsal view.

detailed.name: length of metanotum
detailed.def: The median anatomical line of the metanotum in dorsal view.

detailed.name: length of petiolar node
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the shortest between the center of the petiolar spiracle and the posterior margin of the petiole in lateral view.

detailed.name: ligament
detailed.def: The area that is resilin rich.

detailed.name: ligula
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the glossa and paraglossae.

detailed.name: line
detailed.def: The anatomical structure that is linear.

detailed.name: line of separation
detailed.def: The line that extends along the margins of two sclerites where they are connected to each other by conjunctiva.

detailed.name: lobe
detailed.def: The evagination that is mostly membranous.

detailed.name: lock
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of two sclerite surfaces, that are adjacent to each other and that prevent the movement of a joint.

detailed.name: longitudinal carina of the propleuron
detailed.def: The carina that extends along the lateral margin of the ventral propleural area.

detailed.name: longitudinal line of the dorsal profurcal lamella
detailed.def: The line that crosses the dorsal profurcal lamella and corresponds to the site of origin of the anterior profurcal lamella.

detailed.name: longitudinal metacoxal carina
detailed.def: The carina that is longitudinal and is located on the metacoxa.

detailed.name: longitudinal muscle of the sucking pump
detailed.def: The epipharyngeal muscle that is unpaired and arises from the distal part of the pharyngeal wall and inserts along most of the length of the proximal epipharyngeal wall.

detailed.name: longitudinal ridge on the posterior surface of metatibia
detailed.def: The carina that extends along the posterior surface of the metatibia between the distal and proximal ends of the metatibia.

detailed.name: longitudinal scutellar carina
detailed.def: The carina that is longitudinal and extends between the anterior and posterior margins of the mesoscutellar-axillar complex.

detailed.name: longitudinal sensillum
detailed.def: The multiporous plate sensillum that is elongate.

detailed.name: longitudinal vein
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of abscissae extending along the long axis of the wing.

detailed.name: loral fossa of cardo
detailed.def: The fossa that is on the cardo and articulates with the cardinal condyle of the lorum.

detailed.name: lower face
detailed.def: The area that is limited dorsally by the ventral margin of the antennal foramen laterally by the malar sulcus and ventrally by the oral foramen.

detailed.name: lower mesepimeron
detailed.def: The area that corresponds to the site of origin of the mesopleuro-mesosubalar muscle.

detailed.name: lower tooth
detailed.def: The apical tooth of the mandible that is located the most distal to the clypeus.

detailed.name: macrotergite
detailed.def: The syntergum that is located posteriorly of the petiole.

detailed.name: malar area
detailed.def: The area that extends between the lower (anterior) eye margin and the anterolateral margin of the cranium, and its width is delimited by the width of the mandible.

detailed.name: malar carina
detailed.def: The malar distance that is a carina.

detailed.name: malar depression
detailed.def: The depression that is located immediately above the base of the mandible on the side of the head.

detailed.name: malar groove
detailed.def: The groove that extends between the compound eye and the base of the mandible.

detailed.name: malar line
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the shortest between the lower orbit and the ventrolateral margin of the cranium.

detailed.name: malar striae
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster posterior to the malar sulcus that is composed of carinae radiating from the pleurostomal condyle.

detailed.name: malar sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends between the ventral margin of the compound eye and the base of the mandible.

detailed.name: male genitalia
detailed.def: The genitalia that is part of the male organism.

detailed.name: male genitalia muscle
detailed.def: The abdominal muscle that inserts on the male genitalia.

detailed.name: male organism
detailed.def: Gonochoristic organism that can produce male gametes.

detailed.name: mandible
detailed.def: The appendage that is encircled by one sclerite that is connected to the cranium proximolaterally and to the maxillo-labial complex proximomedially via conjunctivae and articulates with the cranium via the anterior and posterior cranio-mandibular articulations.

detailed.name: mandibular acetabulum
detailed.def: The fossa that is located anteriorly on the proximolateral edge of the mandible and accommodates the pleurostomal coondyle.

detailed.name: mandibular adductor muscle apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme that corresponds to the site of insertion of the mandibular adductor muscle.

detailed.name: mandibular appendage
detailed.def: The area that is located proximoventrally on the mandible, is projected posteriorly and bears posteroventrally oriented rows of spines.

detailed.name: mandibular dentition
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the mandibular teeth.

detailed.name: mandibular gland
detailed.def: The gland that opens mesally at the base of the mandible.

detailed.name: mandibular lancea
detailed.def: The flange that is located on the ventral edge of the mandible, arises from the mandibular condyle and is pointed distally.

detailed.name: mandibular muscle
detailed.def: The head muscle that inserts on the mandible.

detailed.name: mandibular rod
detailed.def: The sclerotised invaginations that are tubular and are inside the mandible.

detailed.name: margin
detailed.def: The line that delimits the periphery of an area.

detailed.name: marginal cilia
detailed.def: The row of setae that is located along the margin of the wing blade in the same plane as the wing blade.

detailed.name: marginal fringe of the stipes
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the spines on the distal margin of the distolateral portion of the principal carina of the stipes.

detailed.name: marginal rim of scutellum
detailed.def: The area that extends along the posterior margin of the mesoscutellum and is delimited anteriorly by the posterior mesoscutellar sulcus.

detailed.name: marginal vein
detailed.def: The abscissa that is located along the anterior margin of the fore wing and is thought to correspond to the anterior abscissa of the radius (R1).

detailed.name: material anatomical entity
detailed.def: Anatomical entity that has mass.

detailed.name: maxilla
detailed.def: The appendage that is encircled by the area that is proximally delimited by the hypostoma posteriorly, the median margin of the mandible laterally, the labrum anterolaterally and the labium medially.

detailed.name: maxillar muscle
detailed.def: The head muscle that inserts on the maxilla.

detailed.name: maxillary gland
detailed.def: The gland that opens medially at the bases of the maxillae.

detailed.name: maxillary palp
detailed.def: The anatomical structure that is distal to the proximal margin of the first sclerite of the maxillary palp.

detailed.name: maxillary palpal socket
detailed.def: The margin of the posterior stipital sclerite that is concave and accommodates the base of the maxillary palp.

detailed.name: maxillary process of the hypostoma
detailed.def: The articular process that bears the cardinal condyle of the cranium.

detailed.name: maximum cephalic length
detailed.def: The median anatomical line that extends between the posterior margin of the cranium and the distal clypeal line in frontal view.

detailed.name: maximum cephalic length in median line
detailed.def: The median anatomical line that extends between the posterior margin of the cranium and the distal margin of the clypeus in frontal view.

detailed.name: maximum diameter
detailed.def: The diameter that is the longest.

detailed.name: maximum diameter of the compound eye
detailed.def: The longest diameter of the eye.

detailed.name: maximum height
detailed.def: The height that is the longest.

detailed.name: maximum height of petiolar node
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the longest between the dorsal margin of the petiole and the posterior petiolar distance and perpendicular to the posterior petiolar distance.

detailed.name: maximum petiole height
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the longest between the ventral margin of the petiole and the dorsal margin of the petiole and is perpendicular to the ventral margin of the petiole in lateral view.

detailed.name: maximum width
detailed.def: The width that is the longest.

detailed.name: mechanosensory hair
detailed.def: The aporous sensillum that has a hairlike cuticular component.

detailed.name: meconium
detailed.def: The acellular anatomical structure that is in the hind gut of the pupa.

detailed.name: medial S9-cupulal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises from the spiculum and inserts on the gonocondyle.

detailed.name: medial apodeme of female S7
detailed.def: The apophysis that is located proximomedially on the female S7.

detailed.name: medial conjunctiva of the first valvula
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that extends medially along the first valvula.

detailed.name: medial coxal articular process of the mesopectus
detailed.def: The articular process that is located on the ventral margin of the mesopectus medially of the mesocoxal foramen and bears the medial coxal condyle of the mesopectus.

detailed.name: medial coxal articular process of the metapectus
detailed.def: The articular process that is located on the ventral margin of the metapectus medially of the metacoxal foramen and bears the medial coxal condyle of the metapectus.

detailed.name: medial coxal condyle of the mesopectus
detailed.def: The medial coxal condyle that is located on the medial coxal articular process of the mesopectus and inserts into the medial pectal fossa of the mesocoxa.

is_a.name: medial coxal condyle of the pectus

relationships.target_name: medial coxal articular process of the mesopectus

detailed.name: medial coxal condyle of the metapectus
detailed.def: The medial coxal condyle of the pectus that is located on the medial coxal articular process of the metapectus and inserts into the medial metapectal fossa of the metacoxa.

is_a.name: medial coxal condyle of the pectus

relationships.target_name: medial coxal articular process of the metapectus

detailed.name: medial coxal condyle of the pectus
detailed.def: The coxal condyle of the pectus that inserts into the medial pectal fossa of the coxa.

detailed.name: medial dististipital process
detailed.def: The rim that is continuous proximally with the stipital thickening, is located distal to the cardino-stipital hinge and articulates distally with tha basal lacinial sclerite.

detailed.name: medial mesofemoro-mesotibial muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises medially (ventrally) from the mesofemur and inserts on the genuflexor plate of the mid leg.

detailed.name: medial mesopecto-mesocoxal articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the medial coxal condyle of the mesopectus and the medial pectal fossa of the mesocoxa.

detailed.name: medial metafemoro-metatibial muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises medially (ventrally) of the hind femur and inserts on the genuflexor plate of the hind leg.

detailed.name: medial metapecto-metacoxal articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the medial coxal condyle of the metapectus and the medial pectal fossa of the metacoxa.

detailed.name: medial pectal fossa of the coxa
detailed.def: The pectal fossa of the coxa that accommodates the median coxal condyle of the pleuron.

detailed.name: medial pectal fossa of the mesocoxa
detailed.def: The medial pectal fossa of the coxa that is located medially on the proximal margin of the mesocoxa and accommodates the medial coxal condyle of the mesopectus.

is_a.name: medial pectal fossa of the coxa

detailed.name: medial pectal fossa of the metacoxa
detailed.def: The medial pectal fossa of the coxa that is located medially on the proximal margin of the metacoxa and accommodates the medial coxal condyle of the metapectus.

is_a.name: medial pectal fossa of the coxa

detailed.name: medial penisvalvo-gonossiculal muscle
detailed.def: The penisvalvo-gonossiculal muscle that is medial to the lateral penisvalvo-gonossiculal muscle and attaches to the basiura.

detailed.name: medial profemoro-protibial muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises medially from the profemur and inserts on the genuflexor plate of the fore leg.

detailed.name: medial propodeal furrow
detailed.def: The impression that is longitudinal and located medially on the abdominal tergum 1.

detailed.name: medial stipital groove
detailed.def: The depression that extends medially and adjacent to the medial portion of the principal carina of stipes.

detailed.name: medial stipital wall
detailed.def: The area that lays parallell with the lateral wall of the prementum.

detailed.name: medial tooth
detailed.def: The projection that is paired and is located submedially on the ventral margin of the ventral rim of clypeus.

detailed.name: medial tooth of the mandible
detailed.def: The apical tooth of mandible that is between the dorsal tooth of mandible and the lower tooth.

detailed.name: medial vein
detailed.def: The wing vein that is posterior to the radial vein and is connected to the anterior margin of the anterior median plate.

detailed.name: median anatomical line
detailed.def: The anatomical line that extends in the median axis of the organism.

detailed.name: median antecostal projection
detailed.def: The projection that extends over the median portion of the antecostal sulcus.

detailed.name: median area of the mesoscutum
detailed.def: The area that is located between the notauli.

detailed.name: median bridge of the second valvifers
detailed.def: The area that connects posterodorsally the second valvifers and is the site of attachment for the posterior T9-second valvifer muscle.

detailed.name: median cardinal cavity
detailed.def: The area that is limited laterally by the mediodistal and basal cardinal ridges.

detailed.name: median carina of clypeus
detailed.def: The clypeal carina that is median.

detailed.name: median carina of lower face
detailed.def: The carina that extends medially on the lower face.

detailed.name: median clypeal notch
detailed.def: The median notch that is on the distal clypeal margin.

detailed.name: median clypeal notch depth
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is between the distal clypeal line and the proximalmost point of the distal clypeal notch in frontal view.

detailed.name: median complex
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of median plates.

detailed.name: median conjunctiva of abdominal tergum 9
detailed.def: The conjunctiva of abdominal tergum 9 that is median and longitudinal.

detailed.name: median conjunctiva of cardines
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that separates the left and the right cardines.

detailed.name: median conjunctiva of the anterior glossal plate
detailed.def: The median conjunctiva of the anterior glossal plate that is parallel with the anteroposterior body axis.

detailed.name: median facial keel
detailed.def: The carina whose dorsal (posterior) region overlaps the facial pit.

detailed.name: median flange of occipital carina
detailed.def: The flange that is median and on the occipital carina.

detailed.name: median frontal septum
detailed.def: The ridge that is unpaired, vertical, is located in the dorsoventral midline of the frons and corresponds to the site of origin of the posterior fronto-labral muscles.

detailed.name: median gonostyle/volsella complex-volsella muscle
detailed.def: The gonostyle/volsella complex-volsellal muscle that arises medially of the submedian conjunctiva on the distoventral margin of gonostyle/volsella complex.

synonyms.name: lateral intrinsic muscle of the volsella

detailed.name: median longitudinal carina of first metasomal sternum
detailed.def: The carina that is located in the anteroposterior median line of the first metasomal sternum.

detailed.name: median longitudinal carina of the metasomal tergum
detailed.def: The carina that is located in the nteroposterior median lineof the metasomal tergum.

detailed.name: median longitudinal furrow of mesoscutellum
