detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the posterior stipital wall, articulates with the cardo and with the labial palp, is connected by conjunctiva distolaterally to the galeo-lacinial complex, proximally to the hypostoma and the cardo and proximolaterally to the mandible.

detailed.name: posterior stipital wall
detailed.def: The area that is limited medially by the medial stipital wall and proximolaterally by the margin of the posterior stipital sclerite.

detailed.name: posterior stipito-palpal muscle
detailed.def: The stipito-palpal muscle that arises medially on the proximal part of the stipes and inserts posteroproximally on the first maxillary palpal segment.

detailed.name: posterior supraalar area
detailed.def: The area that is limited medially by the transmetanotal carina and bears the postmedian metanotal wing process.

detailed.name: posterior surface of the glossa
detailed.def: The area of the glossa that is between the distal margin of the prementum and the distal glossal edge.

detailed.name: posterior tentorial arm
detailed.def: The apodeme that extends between the site of origin of the tentorial bridge and the posterior tentorial pit.

detailed.name: posterior tentorial pit
detailed.def: The tentorial pit that corresponds to posterior tentorial arm.

detailed.name: posterior tentorio-scapal muscle
detailed.def: The antennal muscle that arises medially from the proximal parts of the dorsal and anterior tentorial arms and is inserted posteriorly (dorsally) on the proximal part of the scape.

detailed.name: posterior tentorio-stipital muscle
detailed.def: The tentorio-stipital muscle that is posterior to the anterior tentorio-stipital muscle.

detailed.name: posterior thoracic spiracle
detailed.def: The spiracle that is located dorsally on the border between the mesopectus and the metapectus.

detailed.name: posterior tooth of the mandible
detailed.def: The tooth tooth that is located on the posterior surface of the lower tooth.

detailed.name: posterior trochanteral articular process of the mesocoxa
detailed.def: The articular process that is located posteriorly on the distal margin of the mesocoxa bears the posterior trochanteral condyle of the mesocoxa.

detailed.name: posterior trochanteral articular process of the metacoxa
detailed.def: The articular process that is located posteriorly on the distal margin of the metacoxa and bears the posterior trochanteral condyle of the metacoxa.

detailed.name: posterior trochanteral articular process of the procoxa
detailed.def: The articular process that is located posteriorly on the distal margin of the procoxa and inserts into the posterior coxal fossa of the protrochanter.

detailed.name: posterior trochanteral condyle of the mesocoxa
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the posterior trochanteral articular process of the mesocoxa and inserts into the posterior coxal fossa of the mesotrochanter.

detailed.name: posterior trochanteral condyle of the metacoxa
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the posterior trochanteral articular process of the metacoxa and inserts into the posterior coxal fossa of the metatrochanter.

detailed.name: posterior trochanteral condyle of the procoxa
detailed.def: The condyle that is located the posterior trochanteral articular process of the procoxa and inserts into the posterior coxal fossa of the protrochanter.

relationships.target_name: posterior trochanteral articular process of the procoxa

detailed.name: posterodistal notch of the fore wing
detailed.def: The notch on the posterior wing margin that is adjacent to the posterior end of the discal fold.

detailed.name: posterodorsal branch of pronotal Y
detailed.def: The sulcus that connects the transverse pronotal sulcus and the posterior margin of the pronotum ventral to the anterior thoracic spiracle and together with the ventral portion of the transverse pronotal sulcus delimits anteriorly the site of origin of the pronoto-mesobasalar muscle.

detailed.name: posterodorsal edge of pronotum
detailed.def: The edge that is located at the intersection of the dorsal and lateral margins of the pronotum.

detailed.name: posterodorsal edge of the mesopleuron
detailed.def: The edge that is located at the intersection of the mesepimeral ridge and the inflected dorsal margin of the mesopleuron.

detailed.name: posterodorsal metapleural area
detailed.def: The area that is anterior to the metapecto-propodeal conjunctiva, posterior to the metapleural pit and dorsal to the metapleural sulcus.

detailed.name: posterodorsal metapleural sulcus
detailed.def: The groove on the posterodorsal margin of the metapleuron.

detailed.name: posterolateral mesoscutellar area
detailed.def: The area delimited by the posterolateral mesoscutellar carina and the ventral margin of the mesoscutellum

detailed.name: posterolateral mesoscutellar carina
detailed.def: The carina on the posterodorsal mesoscutellum that is dorsally convex.

detailed.name: posterolateral metacoxo-metatrochanteral muscle
detailed.def: The metatrochanteral muscle that arises posteriorly from the coxa and inserts on the articular membrane of the metacoxo-metatrochanteral joint laterally of the posterior metacoxo-metatrochanteral articulation.

synonyms.name: posterior levator of the hind trochanter

detailed.name: posterolateral metapleuro-metanotal muscle
detailed.def: The metapleuro-metanotal muscle that arises posterolaterally from the metapleuron.

detailed.name: posterolateral pronotal area
detailed.def: The area that is limited anteriorly by the posterolateral pronotal sulcus.

detailed.name: posterolateral pronotal carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends parallel to the posterolateral margin of the pronotum and delimits the posterolateral margin of pronotum.

detailed.name: posterolateral pronotal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that arises from the ventrolateral pit of the pronotum and reaches the posterolateral carina of the pronotum ventral to the anterior thoracic spiracle.

detailed.name: posterolateral tooth-like section of the anterior part of the pronotal plate
detailed.def: The projection that is located submedially on the proximal margin of the pronotal rim.

detailed.name: posteromedian process of the mesoscutellum
detailed.def: The median spine that is on the posterodorsal region of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: posteroventral cavity of female T7
detailed.def: The setal pit that is located at the posterior margin of abdominal tergum 8.

detailed.name: posteroventral corner of metapleuron
detailed.def: The corner at the intersection of the ventrolateral and posterior margin of the metapleuron.

detailed.name: posteroventral corner of the first valvifer
detailed.def: The corner of the first valvifer that is adjacent to the intervalvifer articulation.

detailed.name: posteroventral mesal projection of pronotum
detailed.def: The projection at the ventromedian margin of the pronotum.

detailed.name: posteroventral metapleural pit
detailed.def: The pit that corresponds to the dilator muscle apodeme.

detailed.name: postgena
detailed.def: The area that is located on the occiput ventrally of the occipital foramen.

detailed.name: postgenal bridge
detailed.def: The subforaminal bridge that is sclerotised and limited anteriorly (ventrally) by the hypostomal carina and is subdivided medially by the median sulcus of the postgenal bridge.

detailed.name: postgenal cushion
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is located on the postgena.

detailed.name: postgenal groove
detailed.def: The groove that arises from the lateral margin of the postocciput, is curved externally and extends towards the posterior articulation of the mandible.

detailed.name: postgenal lamella
detailed.def: The carina that extends along the lateral margin of the postgenal groove.

detailed.name: postgenal pit
detailed.def: The pit that corresponds to the ventral-most point of the posterior site of fusion of the ventral lamella of the tentorium.

detailed.name: postgenal ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that extends ventrally of the posterior tentorial pit and that is continuous with the tentorium.

detailed.name: postgenal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that corresponds with the postgenal ridge.

detailed.name: postgenal suture
detailed.def: The groove that is median, vertical and extends between the occipital and oral foramina separating the postgenae.

synonyms.name: longitudinal sulci on ventral head sclerotization
median sulcus of the postgenal bridge

detailed.name: postmarginal vein
detailed.def: The abscissa that is marginal and located distal to the marginal vein.

detailed.name: postmedian metanotal wing process
detailed.def: The fossa that is located anteroventrally on the posterior supraalar area and accommodate the posterior condyle of the first axillary sclerite of the hind wing.

detailed.name: postmedian notal wing process
detailed.def: The fossa that is located on the lateral axillar area and articulates with the posterior end of the first axillary sclerite of the fore wing.

detailed.name: postmental area
detailed.def: The area that is limited distally by the posterior margin of the prementum and laterally by the median margins of the cardines and the stipites.

detailed.name: postmental articular zone
detailed.def: The region that corresponds to the distal margin of the intercardinal area.

detailed.name: postmento-premental hinge
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that is between the postmentum and prementum.

detailed.name: postmento-premental muscle
detailed.def: The labial muscle that is unpaired, arises from the postmentum and inserts on the proximal margin of the prementum.

detailed.name: postmentum
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the sclerites that are on the postmental area.

detailed.name: postnotum
detailed.def: The sclerite that bears the phragma and is located posterior to a notum.

detailed.name: postoccipital carina
detailed.def: The rim that surrounds the occipital foramen.

detailed.name: postoccipital muscle
detailed.def: The head muscle that inserts on the postocciput.

detailed.name: postoccipital ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that corresponds to the postoccipital sulcus.

detailed.name: postoccipital sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that is located on the postoccipital suture.

detailed.name: postoccipital suture
detailed.def: The line that delimits the postocciput from the cranium.

detailed.name: postocciput
detailed.def: The area that is delimited by the postoccipital sulcus or postoccipital carina and the occipital foramen and bears the propleural fossa of the cranium.

detailed.name: postocellar carina
detailed.def: The carina that connects the posterior margins of the left and right lateral ocellar fovea.

detailed.name: postocellar furrow
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends between the posterior margin of the lateral ocelli.

detailed.name: postocular area
detailed.def: The area of the cranium between the dorsal margin of the compound eye and the posterolateral cranial corner.

detailed.name: postocellar vertex
detailed.def: The area posterior to the imaginary line intersecting the lateral ocelli and anterior to the occipital carina.

detailed.name: postocular contour line
detailed.def: The contour line of the postocular area in frontal view.

detailed.name: postocular distance
detailed.def: The median anatomical line of the cranium that is the longest between the dorsal margin of the cranium and the dorsal head width.

detailed.name: postocular head width
detailed.def: The anatomical line between the posteriormost points of the postocular contour lines.

detailed.name: postorbital carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends posteriorly from the genal sulcus.

detailed.name: postpalpal ventral premental area
detailed.def: The area that is posterior to the anatomical line connecting the left and right labial palpal excisions.

detailed.name: postpectal carina
detailed.def: The carina that delimits anterolaterally the mesocoxal depression.

synonyms.name: posterior transverse carina of the mesosternum

detailed.name: postpetiole height
detailed.def: The maximum distance between the dorsal and ventral margin of the postpetiole in lateral view.

detailed.name: postpetiole length
detailed.def: The longest anatomical line that is perpendicular to the posterior margin of the postpetiole in lateral view and is between the posterior postpetiolar margin and the anterior postpetiolar margin.

detailed.name: postpetiole width
detailed.def: The maximum width of the postpetiole in dorsal view.

detailed.name: postphragma
detailed.def: The phragma that is located posteriorly on a thoracic segment.

detailed.name: postscutellum
detailed.def: The area that is located medially on the dorsellum and bears the metanotal flange.

detailed.name: postspiracular furrow
detailed.def: The groove that is longitudinal and is immediately posterior or postero-medial to the first abdominal spiracle.

detailed.name: poststernite
detailed.def: The area corresponding to the postcostal lip of a definitive sternal plate that includes the intersegmental sclerotization following.

detailed.name: posttergite
detailed.def: The area that corresponds to the narrow postcostal lip of a postnotal thoracic plate.

detailed.name: pouch
detailed.def: The area that is located on the conjunctiva and invaginated.

detailed.name: pre-apical ledge
detailed.def: The area that is convave and extends along the distal margin of the scape and is delimited proximally by a carina.

detailed.name: prealare
detailed.comment: There is no prescutal regiaon differenciated in Hymenoptera.

detailed.name: preapical tibial spurs
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the spurs that are proximal to the distal margin of the tibia.

detailed.name: preapical tooth
detailed.def: The tooth that is located distodorsally on the mandible.

detailed.name: prearticular incisure
detailed.def: The notch that is located on the margin of the second valvifer immediately anterior to the basal articulation of the second valvulae.

detailed.name: prearticular portion of the postmentum
detailed.def: The interstipital sclerite that is connected proximally to the postarticular portion of the postmentum.

detailed.name: preaxilla
detailed.def: The area that is delimited laterally by the parascutal carina, adjacent to the tegula anteriorly and bears the anterior and antemedian mesonotal wing processes.

detailed.name: preaxillar carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends across the preaxilla and separates the articulation area for the tegula.

detailed.name: precoxal carina
detailed.def: The carina that corresponds to the transepisternal line.

detailed.name: precoxal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that corresponds to the transepisternal line.

detailed.name: premental arm
detailed.def: The area of the lateral premental face that receives the site of origin of the dorsal premento-salivarial muscle.

detailed.name: premental carina
detailed.def: The flange that is adjacent to the border between the ventral and lateral premental faces and that overlaps externally the median part of the posterior stipital sclerite.

detailed.name: premental ditch
detailed.def: The scrobe of the prementum that is adjacent to and extends lateral to the premental carina and accommodates the medial part of the posterior stipital sclerite.

detailed.name: premento-glossal muscle
detailed.def: The labial muscle that arises on the ventral part of the prementum, laterally to the ventral premento-salivarial muscle and inserts on the anterior glossal plate.

detailed.name: premento-palpal muscle
detailed.def: The labial muscle that arises from the prementum and inserts on the first sclerite of the labial palp.

detailed.name: prementum
detailed.def: The sclerite that is median, is connected via conjunctiva along its proximolateral margins to the stipites, is articulated with the labial palps, is continuous along its distal margin with the ligula and distolateral margins with the distal hypopharynx and receives the site of attachments of the extrinsic labial palp muscles.

detailed.name: premento-paraglossal muscle
detailed.def: The labial muscle that arises from the ventral part of the prementum, anterior to the origin of the premento-glossal muscle and ventral premento-salivarial muscle and inserts just distally of the distal margin of the prementum.

detailed.name: preoccipital carina
detailed.def: The carina that is transverse and extends posteriorly of the lateral ocelli and compound eye and delimits anteriorly the preoccipital lunula.

detailed.name: preoccipital furrow
detailed.def: The sulcus that arises medially from the anterior margin of the occipital carina and extends towards the anterior ocellus.

detailed.name: preoccipital lunula
detailed.def: The area that is concave, is located on the vertex and is limited anteriorly by the preoccipital carina and posteriorly by the occipital carina.

detailed.name: preocellar pit
detailed.def: The pit that is located on upper face adjacent the anterior margin of the median ocellus and corresponds internally to a conical apodeme and not the tentorium.

detailed.name: preomaular area
detailed.def: The area that is limited posteriorly by the omaulus and ventromedially by the epicnemium.

detailed.name: preoral cavity
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that includes the labrum, hypopharynx and labium.

detailed.name: preorbital carina
detailed.def: The carina that is located on the face, parallels the inner orbit and is paired.

detailed.name: preorbital suture
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends along the median margin of the preorbital trabecula.

detailed.name: preorbital trabecula
detailed.def: The bar that extends along the inner orbit and terminates dorsally at the juncture of the transverse trabecula and supraorbital trabecula.

detailed.name: prepalpal ventral premental area
detailed.def: The area that is anterior to the anatomical line connecting the left and right labial palpal excisions.

detailed.name: prepectal carina
detailed.def: The carina that divides the prepectus for the vertical lateral portion and the horizontal, ventral prepectal shelf.

detailed.name: prepectal shelf
detailed.def: The area that is horizontal and located ventrally on the prepectus.

detailed.name: prepecto-anterior thoracic spiracle muscle
detailed.def: The anterior thoracic spiracle occlusor muscle that originates from the prepectus and inserts on the mesothoracic spiracle.

detailed.name: prepecto-mesobasalar muscle
detailed.def: The mesobasalar muscle that arises from the prepectus.

detailed.name: prepecto-procoxal muscle
detailed.def: The procoxal muscle that arises from the prepectus.

detailed.name: prepectus
detailed.def: The intersegmentalia that is located on the mesopectus-pronotum intersegmental membrane and corresponds to the site of origin of the anterior thoracic spiracle occlusor muscle.

detailed.name: prescutal ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that seperates the prescutum from scutum.

detailed.name: prescutal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that sets off the prescutum from the scutum and corresponds to the prescutal ridge.

detailed.name: prescutum
detailed.def: The area that is located on the alinotum and is limited by the antecostal suture and prescutal suture.

detailed.name: prespecular sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that delimits anteriorly the speculum and corresponds to the anterior margin of the speculum.

detailed.name: prespiracular carina
detailed.def: The carina that delimits the spiracular furrow medially.

detailed.name: presternum
detailed.def: The area that is located on the basisternum and is delimited by the sternacostal sulcus.

detailed.name: prespiracular propodeal area
detailed.def: The area that is located between the first metasomal spiracle and metapleural arm and delimited laterally by the metapleural carina.

detailed.name: prestigma
detailed.def: The patch that is enlarged, sclerotized, and located at the apex of one or more wing veins on the anterior margin of the wing.

detailed.name: pretarsus
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is apical to the telotarsus and composed of the empodium, auxilia, planta, pulvillum, unguis, unguitractor plate, auxiliar sclerite and manubrium.

detailed.name: pretarsus of mesotarsus
detailed.def: The pretarsus that is located on the mesotarsus.

detailed.name: pretarsus of metatarsus
detailed.def: The pretarsus that is located in the metatasrus.

detailed.name: pretarsus of protarsus
detailed.def: The pretarsus that is located in the protarsus.

detailed.name: primary gonopore
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is the transition from the ductus ejaculatorius to the endophallus and therefore the transition from the internal to the external male genitalia.

detailed.name: principal carina of stipes
detailed.def: The flange that extends along the margin of the posterior stipital wall.

detailed.name: probasicoxite
detailed.def: The basicoxite that is located on the procoxa.

detailed.name: probasisternum
detailed.def: The basisternum that is located in the propectus.

detailed.name: probasitarsus
detailed.def: The basitarsus that is located on the protarsus.

detailed.name: proboscidial fossa
detailed.def: The scrobe that is located medially on the hypostoma and accommodates the proboscis.

detailed.name: process
detailed.def: The area on the sclerite that is raised.

detailed.name: processus articularis

detailed.name: salivary duct
detailed.def: The duct that leads from the salivary gland.

detailed.name: salivary gland
detailed.def: The gland that empties anterior to the prementum.

detailed.name: sawtooth
detailed.def: The process that is located along the ventral margin of the first valvula or the dorsal margin of the second valvula.

detailed.name: scale
detailed.def: The sensillum with a scale-like cuticular component.

detailed.name: scape
detailed.def: The antennal segment that is proximal to the pedicel and is connected to the head via the radicle.

detailed.name: scape length
detailed.def: The proximodistal anatomical line of the scapal area that is distal to the radicle.

detailed.name: scapular flange
detailed.def: The area that is set off from the lateral area of the mesoscutum by the anteriorly extended dorsal axillar area.

detailed.name: sclerite of the maxillary palp
detailed.def: The sclerite that is part of the maxillary palp.

detailed.name: sclerite
detailed.def: The area of the cuticle that is less flexible than adjacent conjunctivae.

detailed.name: scopa
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is used for pollen storage.

detailed.name: scrobal carina of the mesoscutum
detailed.def: The carina that delimits laterally the cranial scrobe of the mesoscutum.

detailed.name: scrobal depression
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of antennal scrobes.

detailed.name: scrobal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends dorsomedially from the upper median margin of the antennal rim.

detailed.name: scrobe
detailed.def: The area that is impressed and is for the reception or concealment of another sclerite.

detailed.name: sculpture
detailed.def: The area that is located on the sclerite and that is composed of repetitive anatomical structures.

detailed.name: scute
detailed.def: The area that is 5–35 µm wide, polygonal, repetitive, is delimited by lines and is the element of the reticulate sculpture.

detailed.name: scutellar bridge
detailed.def: The apodeme that originates from the scutoscutellar ridge and fuses with the posterior part of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: scutellar disc
detailed.def: The area that is median, convex and is delimited anteriorly by the scutoscutellar sulcus and laterally by the axillar depression.

detailed.name: scutellar fovea
detailed.def: The depression that is medially located on the scutoscutellar suture.

detailed.name: scutellar plate
detailed.def: The area that is located medially on the mesoscutellum, flat and surrounds the scutellar midpit.

detailed.name: scutellar rim
detailed.def: Tha carina that extends externally of the scutellar plate and is parallel to the margin of the scutellar plate.

detailed.name: scutellar sensillum
detailed.def: The campaniform sensilla that is paired and is located submedially on the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: scutellar spine
detailed.def: The spine that is located posteromedially on the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: scutellar tubercular projection
detailed.def: The process that is located just medially of the margin of the scutellar plate.

detailed.name: scutellum
detailed.def: The area that is located posteriorly of the scutoscutellar suture.

detailed.name: scutoscutellar ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that extends along the anterior margin of the mesoscutellum and corresponds to the scutoscutellar suture.

detailed.name: scutoscutellar sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends along the scutoscutellar suture.

detailed.name: scutoscutellar suture
detailed.def: The line that traverses the mesonotum between the postmedian notal wing processes.

detailed.name: scutum
detailed.def: The area that is located on the alinotum and is situated anterior to the scutoscutellar suture.

detailed.name: second abdominal sternal muscle
detailed.def: The abdominal muscle that inserts on the second abdominal sternum.

detailed.name: second abdominal tergal muscle
detailed.def: The abdominal muscle that inserts on the second abdominal tergum.

detailed.name: second axillary sclerite
detailed.def: The axillary sclerite that articulates ventrally with the pleuron and medially with the first axillary sclerite, posteriorly with the third axillary sclerite and is connected with the base of the radial vein.

detailed.name: second axillary sclerite of the fore wing
detailed.def: The second axillary sclerite  that is located on the mesothorax.

detailed.name: second flagellomere
detailed.def: The flagellomere that is located immediately distal to the first flagellomere.

detailed.name: second intrinsic muscle of the labial palp
detailed.def: The muscle that arises from the second sclerite of the labial palp and inserts on the third sclerite of the labial palp.

relationships.target_name: second sclerite of the labial palp
third sclerite of the labial palp

detailed.name: second intrinsic muscle of the maxillary palp
detailed.def: The muscle that arises from the first sclerite of the maxillary palp and inserts on the third sclerite of the maxillary palp.

relationships.target_name: first sclerite of the maxillary palp
third sclerite of the maxillary palp

detailed.name: second lateral area
detailed.def: The area of propodeal-metapectal complex that is posterior to the first lateral area and medial to the lateral longitudinal carina.

detailed.name: second median plate
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located at the base of the mediocubital field, folding convexly on the outer edge of the first median plate along the plica basalis.

detailed.name: second mesopleuro-mesonotal muscle
detailed.def: The mesonotal muscle that arises medially from mesopleuron and inserts on the ventral surface of the lateral axillar area.

detailed.name: second mesopleuro-third axillary sclerite of fore wing muscle
detailed.def: The fore wing third axillary muscle that arises anteroventrally from the mesopleuron.

synonyms.name: anterior mesopleuro-third axillary sclerite of fore wing muscle
second mesopleuro-third axillary sclerite of fore wing

relationships.target_name: third axillary sclerite of the fore wing

detailed.name: second phragmo-third phragmal muscle
detailed.def: The metaphragmal muscle that arises from the mesophragma and inserts on the metaphragma.

detailed.name: second sclerite of the labial palp
detailed.def: The sclerite that is ringlike and is connected distally to the first sclerite of the labial palp via conjunctiva and muscle.

detailed.name: second sclerite of the maxillary palp
detailed.def: The sclerite that is ringlike and is connected distally to the first sclerite of the maxillary palp via conjunctiva and muscle.

detailed.name: second sterno-metacoxal muscle
detailed.def: The metacoxal muscle that arises from the second abdominal sternum.

detailed.name: second tarsomere
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is distal to the basitarsus and proximal to the third tarsomere.

detailed.name: second tarsomere of fore leg
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is distal to and connected to the probasitarsus.

detailed.name: second tarsomere of hind leg
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is distal to and connected to the first tarsomere of the hind leg.

detailed.name: second tarsomere of mid leg
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is distal to and connected to the first tarsomere of the mid leg.

detailed.name: second valvifer
detailed.def: The area of the second valvifer-second valvula-third valvula complex that is proximal to the basal articulation and to the processus musculares and articulates with female T9.

detailed.name: second valvifer-genital membrane muscle
detailed.def: The ovipositor muscle that arises anteriorly from the dorsal flange of the second valvifer and inserts anteriorly on the dorsal part of the genital membrane.

detailed.name: second valvifer-second valvula-third valvula complex
detailed.def: The area that is connected to the ninth tergite and the first valvifer via conjunctiva, is articulated to the first tergite, and bears the aulax.

detailed.name: second valvifer-third valvula complex
detailed.def: The area of the second valvifer-second valvula-third valvula complex that is proximal to the basal articulation.

detailed.name: second valvula
detailed.def: The area of the second valvifer-second valvula-third valvula complex that is distal to the basal articulation and to the processus musculares and is limited medially by the median body axis.

detailed.name: second valviferal condyle of the first valvifer
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the first valvifer and articulates with the first valviferal fossa of the second valvifer.

detailed.name: secretory pore
detailed.def: The anatomical space that corresponds to the distal end of an exocrine gland.

detailed.name: segment
detailed.def: An anatomical structure that is metameric and is connected to other metameric subdivisions by muscles and is delimited by its sclerites.

detailed.name: sense organ
detailed.def: Multicellular anatomical structure with largely bona fide boundary that transduces some sensory stimulus to the nervous system.

detailed.name: semen
detailed.def: The portion of tissue that is produced by the gland cells of the internal male genitalia.

detailed.name: sensillar patch
detailed.def: The patch that differs from surrounding region by presence of sensilla.

detailed.name: sensillar patch of the male flagellomere
detailed.def: The sensillar patch that is located on the ventral surface of the male flagellomere.

detailed.name: sensillar patch of the second valvifer
detailed.def: The patch that is composed of placoid sensilla adjacent to the intervalvifer articulation.

detailed.name: sensillar plate of the aedeagus
detailed.def: The distal region of the aedeagus that is flat (delimited by an edge from the rest of the aedeagus) and bears four sensillum basiconicum.

detailed.name: sensillar ring of harpe
detailed.def: The row of setae on the distomedial harpal wall that is parallel to the harpal margin.

detailed.name: sensillar row of the 2nd valvifer
detailed.def: The row of styloconic sensilla along the proximal margin of the anterior area of the second valvifer.

synonyms.name: sensilla on edge of the second valvifers

relationships.target_name: anterior area of the second valvifer

detailed.name: sensillum basiconicum
detailed.def: The trichoid sensillum that is apically rounded.

detailed.name: sensillum
detailed.def: A sense organ embedded in the integument and consisting of one or a cluster of sensory neurons and associated sensory structures, support cells and glial cells forming a single organized unit with a largely bona fide boundary.

detailed.name: sensillum coeloconicum A
detailed.def: The sensillum coeloconicum, in which the diameter of the tip of the hairlike cuticular component is 1/3-1/5 of the diameter of the surrounding depression.

detailed.name: sensillum coeloconicum B
detailed.def: The sensillum coeloconicum, in which the diameter of the tip of the hairlike cuticular component is as wide as the surrounding depression.

detailed.name: sensillum trichodeum curvatum
detailed.def: The sensillum that is curved.

detailed.name: sequential hermaphroditic organism
detailed.def: Hermaphroditic organism that produces gametes first of one sex, and then later of the other sex.

detailed.name: serrula
detailed.def: The notch that is located on the margin of sawtooth.

detailed.name: seta
detailed.comment: This class, based on its primary definition, is equivalent with HAO:0000933 (mx:865). Uri tables that used this class refer 0002299.

detailed.name: setal angle
detailed.def: The angle of the proximodistal axis of the seta to the contour line of the bodypart where the seta is located.

detailed.name: setal line
detailed.def: The row of setae that is located on the fore wing.

detailed.name: setal pit
detailed.def: The impression with a centered seta.

detailed.name: setiferous patch
detailed.def: The patch that differs from the surrounding region by having denser setae.

detailed.name: seventh flagellomere
detailed.def: The flagellomere that is located immediately distal to the sixth flagellomere.

detailed.name: sex flagellomere
detailed.def: The flagellomere that is modified and located on a male organism.

detailed.name: signum
detailed.def: The area that corresponds to the site of the origin of a muscle.

detailed.name: simple columnar epithelium
detailed.def: Unilaminar epithelium that consists of a single layer of columnar cells.

detailed.name: simple cuboidal epithelium
detailed.def: Unilaminar epithelium that consists of a single layer of cuboidal cells.

detailed.name: simple organ
detailed.def: Multi-tissue structure that is not part of a compound organ.

detailed.name: simple squamous epithelium
detailed.def: Unilaminar epithelium that consists of a single layer of squamous cells.

detailed.name: sitophore
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located in the proximal part of the hypopharygeal wall delimited distally by the functional mouth and proximally by the proximal boundary of the cibarium. The tentorio-hypopharyngeal muscle inserts on the proximal margin of the sitophore.

detailed.name: sixth flagellomere
detailed.def: The flagellomere that is located immediately distal to the fifth flagellomere.

detailed.name: sixth maxillary palpal sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is ringlike and is connected via conjunctiva distally to the fifth sclerite of the maxillary palp via conjunctiva.

detailed.name: skaphion
detailed.def: The area that is anteriorly on the mesonotum and delimited posteriorly by the skaphion carina.

detailed.name: skaphion carina
detailed.def: The carina that delimits the skaphion posteriorly.

detailed.name: skeletal muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that is attached at either end to the cuticle.

detailed.name: socketed spine peg
detailed.def: The flattened mechanosensory hair on the ventral margin of the mandible.

detailed.name: solid compound organ
detailed.def: Compound organ that does not contain macroscopic anatomical spaces.

detailed.name: spatha
detailed.def: The sclerite that is unpaired and located just dorsally of the basal part of the aedeagus in some Aculeata.

detailed.name: specialized adhesive spur
detailed.def: The spur that is located on the tibia and is adhesive.

detailed.name: specialized area of mesoscutellum
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is located posteromedially on the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: specillum
detailed.def: The median, smooth area that is smooth, is surrounded by sculptured areas and is on the abdominal mediotergite 4.

detailed.name: speculum
detailed.def: The area that is located dorsolaterally on the mesosoma, is delimited posteriorly by the mesepimeral ridge and corresponds to the site of origin of the anterior mesopleuro-mesofurcal muscle.

detailed.name: spermatheca
detailed.def: The invagination just proximal to the vagina that accommodates sperms.

detailed.name: sperone
detailed.def: The longitudinal ridge on medially on the internal surface of the distal region of the second valvula. second valvula.

detailed.name: spiculate patch of lacinia
detailed.def: The area on the lacinial lobe that is covered with acanthae.

detailed.name: spiculate patch of the galea
detailed.def: The area on the galeo-lacinial complex distal to the lacinial lobe that is covered with acanthae.

detailed.name: spiculum
detailed.def: The apophysis that is located medially on the anterior margin of the abdominal sternum 9 and corresponds to the site of origin of the mediolateral S9-cupulal muscles.

synonyms.name: basal apodeme of ninth abdominal sternum

detailed.name: spina
detailed.def: The apophysis that is located medially on the spinasternum.

detailed.name: spinasternum
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located anteriorly on the thoracic sternum and bears the spina.

detailed.name: spine
detailed.def: The process that lacks non-sclerotised ring at the base.

detailed.name: spiracle
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the distal end of the trachea and the margin of the sclerite or conjunctiva surrounding the spiracular opening.

detailed.name: spine length
detailed.def: The anatomical line between the center of the propodeal spiracle and the distal end of the propodeal spine.

detailed.name: spiracular groove
detailed.def: The impression that extends dorsally on the metapectal-propodeal complex from its anterior margin to the first abdominal spiracle.

detailed.name: spiracular muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that inserts to the spiracle.

detailed.name: spur
detailed.def: The process that is surrounded by conjunctiva and evaginated and that is basally sclerotized.

detailed.name: squama
detailed.def: The area that is heavily pigmented, raised and located proximally on the harpe.

detailed.name: sternacostal suture
detailed.def: The suture that extends along the border of the basisternum and sternellum.

detailed.name: sternal apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located on the abdominal sternite and serves as the site of origin of muscles.

detailed.name: sternal muscle
detailed.def: The abdominal muscle that inserts on the abdominal sternum.

detailed.name: sternaular area
detailed.def: The area that is located between the epicnemial carina and the anterior margin of the femoral depression.

detailed.name: sternaulus
detailed.def: The line that marks the site of origin of the mesopleuro-basalare and first mesopleuro-mesonotal muscle.

detailed.name: sternaulus length
detailed.def: The straight anatomical line between the anterior and posterior ends of the sternaulus.

detailed.name: sternellum
detailed.def: The area that is located on the eusternum posteriorly of the site of origin of the furca.

detailed.name: sternite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the sternum.

detailed.name: sternopleurite
detailed.def: The pleurite that located medially of the coxa and laterally of the sternum.

detailed.name: sternum
detailed.def: The area that is located on the integument and is ventral of the ventral diaphragm.

detailed.name: stigma
detailed.def: The patch on the wing that is sclerotized and is on the anterior margin of the fore wing.

detailed.name: stigmal vein
detailed.def: The vein that is adjacent proximally to the pterostigma.

detailed.name: stipes
detailed.def: The appendage that is connected posteroproximally to the hypostoma, anteroproximally and lateroproximally to the mandible and medioproximally to the labium and the hypopharynx via conjunctiva, is connected to the cranium via muscles and that bears the maxillary palp.

detailed.name: stipital fossa of the cardo
detailed.def: The fossa that articulates with the basistipital process.

detailed.name: stipital sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is on the medial stipital wall and bears the medial stipital process.

detailed.name: stipital thickening
detailed.def: The rim that extends along the anterior (dorsal) margin of the medial stipital wall.

detailed.name: stipito-galeal muscle
detailed.def: The maxillar muscle that arises from the posterior sclerite of the stipes medial to the site of origin of the stipito-lacinial muscle and inserts on the median wall of the galeo-lacinial complex distal to the stipito-lacinial muscle.

detailed.name: stipito-lacinial muscle
detailed.def: The maxillar muscle that arises along the lateral margin of the posterior stipital sclerite and inserts proximally on the median wall of the stipes just proximal to the lacinal lobe.

detailed.name: stipito-palpal muscle
detailed.def: The maxillary muscle that arises from the posterior stipital sclerite and inserts on the first sclerite of the maxillary palp.

relationships.target_name: first sclerite of the maxillary palp

detailed.name: stipito-premental conjunctiva
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that extends along the posterior (dorsal) margin of the premental arm and the proximal margin of the medial stipital wall.

detailed.name: stridulatory organ
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the plectrum and the stridulitrum.

detailed.name: stridulitrum
detailed.def: The area that is composed of file-like ridges on the upper surface of the anterior tergum of abdominal segment 4.

detailed.name: strigilis
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed by transverse rows of setae on the median (posterior, inner) surface of the metabasitarsus.

detailed.name: sturdy spines of the hind femur
detailed.def: The spine that is located on the ventral face of the metafemur.

detailed.name: styloconic sensillum
detailed.def: The seta that is on a process.

detailed.name: stylus of the third valvula
detailed.def: The sclerite that is connected to the distal end of the third valvula via conjunctiva.

detailed.name: subacropleural sulcus
detailed.def: The groove ventral to the acropleural sulcus and anterior to the prespecular sulcus that extends toward the mesopleural pit.

detailed.name: subalar area
detailed.def: The area that is delimited by the mesepimeral inflection and corresponding subalar ridge and bears the mesopleural wing process.

detailed.name: subalar pit
detailed.def: The pit that is located posterodorsally on the mesopectus corresponds to the posterodorsal edge of the mesopleuron.

detailed.name: subalar ridge
detailed.def: The carina that corresponds with the mesepimeral inflection and delimits the subalar area.

detailed.name: subalare
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the dorsal margin of the pterothoracic pectus posterior to the pleural wing articulation.

detailed.name: subantennal area
detailed.def: The area that is located ventrally of the antennal rim and is delimited by the subantennal grooves and the epistomal sulcus.

detailed.name: subantennal carina
detailed.def: The carina that is located on the lower face ventrally of the antennal foramen and dorsally of the clypeus.

detailed.name: subantennal groove
detailed.def: The scrobe that is located ventrally of the antennal foramen and accommodates the proximal part of the antenna.

detailed.name: subapical genal tooth
detailed.def: The projection at the ventral end of the genal carina.

detailed.name: subapical tooth
detailed.def: The projection that is located on the distal half of the tarsal claw and proximal to the apex.

synonyms.name: lobe at the base of the tarsal claws

detailed.name: subaxillular bar
detailed.def: The area that is elevated, located on the lateroventral margin of the mesoscutellar axillar complex and is continuous anteriorly with the postalar process.

detailed.name: subcalyptral area
detailed.def: The area of the propodeum that is  delimited dorsally by the calyptra and posteriorly delimited by the lateral propodeal carina.

detailed.name: subcosta
detailed.def: The wing vein that is connected to the first axillary sclerite and extends posterior to the costa.

detailed.name: subcoxa
detailed.comment: There is no subcoxa in Hymenoptera, the definition is a theory.

detailed.name: subforaminal bridge
detailed.def: The area that is located between the oral and the occipital foramina.

detailed.name: subgenal carina
detailed.def: The carina that is located on the cranium, ventrally of the gena and extending from the hypostomal carina to the facial articulation of the mandible.

detailed.name: subgenal coronet
detailed.def: The row of setae that extends along the carina paramandibular process and curves behind the mandibular base.

detailed.name: subglossal brush
detailed.def: The row of setae that is located laterally at the base of the glossa.

detailed.name: sublateral carina of tergum
detailed.def: The carina that is longitudinal and sublateral.

detailed.name: sublateral groove
detailed.comment: no reference, the class is already defined using different labels.

detailed.name: subligular process
detailed.def: The area of the prementum that is located between the labial palpal excisions and is limited posteriorly by the anatomical line extending between the proximalmost points of the excisions.

detailed.name: submarginal carina of abdominal tergite
detailed.def: The carina that extends laterally on the abdominal tergite.

detailed.name: submarginal groove
detailed.def: The impression extends along the lateral margin of the metasomal mediotergite.

detailed.name: submarginal vein
detailed.def: Basal-most portion of the forewing vein complex that occurs behind the costal cell; measured from the constriction that delimits the humeral plate to the point at which the vein touches the leading edge of the wing apically.

detailed.name: submedial flange of occipital carina
detailed.def: The flange that is submedial and is on the occipital carina.

detailed.name: submedial notch on distoventral margin of gonostyle/volsella complex
detailed.def: The notch that is on the distoventral margin of the gonostyle/volsella complex laterally of the gonostyle/volsella complex-gonossiculus articulation.

detailed.name: submedian area of clypeus
detailed.def: The area between the median carina of clypeus and the lateral carina of clypeus.

detailed.name: submedian carina
detailed.def: The carina that arises from the anterior mandibular articulation that is located medially of the orbital carina and laterally of the frontal carina.

detailed.name: submedian carina of propodeum
detailed.def: The carina that is longitudinal and extends closer to the midline than to the lateral margin of the propodeum.

detailed.name: submedian conjunctiva on the distoventral margin of gonostyle/volsella complex
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that is elongate, is on the distoventral margin of the gonostyle/volsella complex and delimits laterally the site of origin of the gonostyle/volsella complex-gonossiculus muscle.

detailed.name: submedian groove
detailed.def: The line that is lobgitudinal and is located  closer to the midline than to the lateral margin of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: submedian lines of scutellum
detailed.def: The submedial anteroposterior sulcus on the mesoscutellar axillar complex that is paired.

detailed.name: submedian patch on abdominal T7
detailed.def: The patch that is defined by leather-like microsculpture on the anterior region of abdominal T7 lateral to the Waterston's evaporatorium.

detailed.name: submedian pronotal apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located submedially just ventrally of the dorsal margin of the pronotum and corresponds to the site of origin of the pronoto-propleural muscle.

detailed.name: submetapleural carina
detailed.def: The carina that is located along the ventral metapleural margin, between the mesocoxal foramen and metacoxal foramen.

detailed.name: submetapleural ridge
detailed.def: The carina that extends from the ventral margin of the spiracular groove to the anterior margin of the metapectal-propodeal complex.

detailed.name: subocular area
detailed.def: The area that is located between the malar sulcus and preorbital suture.

detailed.name: subomaulus
detailed.def: The area that is located on the epicnemial carina anteriorly of the site of origin of the omaulus.

detailed.name: subpetiolar process
detailed.def: The process that is located anteroventrally on the petiole.

detailed.name: subpleural signum
detailed.def: The signum that is located submedially on the ventral face of the mesopleuron. The subpleural signum corresponds to the site of origin of the first mesopleuro-mesonotal (pl2-t2a) muscle.

detailed.name: subpleuron
detailed.def: The area that is located ventrally on the pectus.

detailed.name: subsalivarial gland
detailed.def: The gland that is situated ventrally of the salivarium and empties into the salivarium.

detailed.name: subtorular carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends ventrally from the lateral margin of the antennal rim.

detailed.name: sulcus
detailed.def: The groove that corresponds to a ridge.

detailed.name: supra-marginal carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends laterally on the mesonotum along the mesoscutal suprahumeral sulcus.

detailed.name: supraclypeal area
detailed.def: The area that is located medially on the lower face between the dorsal margin of the clypeus and the anatomical line that connects the dorsalmost points of the left and right antennal rims.

detailed.name: supraalar area
detailed.def: The area that is located laterally of the longitudinal metanotal carina.

detailed.name: supraclypeal depression
detailed.def: The median impression on the frons that is dorsal to the intertorular carina and is not a scrobe for receiving the scape.

detailed.name: supramesopleural sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located anterodorsally on the metapectus, posterior to the postalar process.

detailed.name: supraorbital suture
detailed.def: The sulcus that delimits anteriorly the supraorbital trabecula.

detailed.name: supraorbital trabecula
detailed.def: The bar that is adjacent to and parallel with the upper margin of each eye, which anteriorly terminates at the juncture of the transverse trabecula and preorbital trabecula.

detailed.name: surcoxal depression
detailed.def: The depression that is located anteroventrally on the mesopectus anterior of the precoxal carina.

detailed.name: suture

detailed.def: The pronoto-procoxal muscle that originates anteroventrally from the pronotum and inserts posterolaterally on the procoxa.

detailed.name: ventral propleural area
detailed.def: The area that is located ventrally on the propleuron and is delimited laterally by the longitudinal carina of the propleuron.

detailed.name: ventral propodeal carina
detailed.def: The carina that separates the metasomal depression from the metacoxal depression.

detailed.name: ventral protibio-probasitarsal muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises ventrally from the protibia and inserts ventrally on the articular membrane of the protibio-probasitarsal joint.

detailed.name: ventral ridge of clypeus
detailed.def: The ridge that arises medially from the pleurostomal condyle and corresponds to the site of attachment of the labrum.

detailed.name: ventral rim of clypeus
detailed.def: The rim that extends along the distal margin of the clypeus.

detailed.name: ventral rod of aedeagus
detailed.def: The apodeme that arises distoventrally from the aedeagus and is continuous with the ventromedian conjunctiva of the gonostyle/volsella complex.

detailed.name: ventral row of spines
detailed.def: The row that is composed of spines and is located ventrally on the apex of the calcar.

detailed.name: ventral ramus of the second valvula
detailed.def: The area of the second valvifer-second vavula-third valvifer complex that bears the rhachis.

detailed.name: ventral salivarial dilatator
detailed.def: The salivarial muscle that arises from the proximal end of the ventral part of the prementum and inserts on the salivarial sclerite.

detailed.name: ventral sclerite of the first valvifer
detailed.def: The sclerite of the first valvifer that is ventral to the transvalviferal conjunctiva.

detailed.name: ventral spine of hypopygium
detailed.def: The area that is median and projecting posteriorly.

detailed.name: ventral vertical lobe of the propleuron
detailed.def: The area that is limited dorsally (anteriorly) by the ventral edge of the propleuron.

detailed.name: ventral wall of the second valvulae
detailed.def: The ventral, usually weakly sclerotized region of the second valvulae, that is medially continuous with the rachises.

detailed.name: ventrolateral basiglossal arm
detailed.def: The projection that is located proximolaterally on the anterior glossal plate and articulates with the basiparaglossal sclerite.

detailed.name: ventrolateral cupolo-gonostyle/volsella complex
detailed.def: The cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscle that inserts ventrolaterally on the gonostyle/volsella complex between the site of insertion of the ventromedial and dorsolateral cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscles.

detailed.name: ventrolateral invagination of the pronotum
detailed.def: The invagination that at the ventrolateral edge of the pronotum.

detailed.name: ventrolateral setiferous patch
detailed.def: The sublateral setiferous patch that is on the frons between the intertorular carina and the facial pit, and is separated from the median setiferous patch by the supraclypeal depression.

detailed.name: ventromedial cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscle
detailed.def: The cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscle that inserts medially on the ventral region of the gonostyle/volsella complex.

detailed.name: ventromedian apodeme of the aedeagus
detailed.def: The apodeme that arises distoventrally from the aedeagus and is not continuous with the ventromedian conjunctiva of the gonostyle/volsella complex.

detailed.name: ventromedian setiferous patch
detailed.def: The median setiferous patch that is on the frons between the intertorular carina and the facial pit.

detailed.name: verricule
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is composed of closely gathered setae.

detailed.name: vertex
detailed.def: The area that is delimited by the intersection of the margin of the compound eyes, the interorbital plane, and the anatomical line that is tangential to the point on the margin of the anterior ocellus which defines the minimum distance between the anterior ocellus and the oral foramen.

detailed.name: vertex patch
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is located on the vertex.

detailed.name: vertexal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that is horizontal and extends between the compound eye and the lateral ocellus.

detailed.name: vertical apodemal lobe of the mesoscutellum
detailed.def: The inflection that extends along the posterolateral margin of the mesoscutellum and articulates with the dorsal propodeal inflection.

detailed.name: vertical epomia
detailed.def: The carina that is the vertical section of the epomial carina that begins ventrally and terminates at the junction of the transverse pronotal carina and the lateral epomia.

detailed.name: vertical lobe of mesoscutum
detailed.def: The inflection that extends ventrally along the anterolateral margin of the mesoscutum.

detailed.name: vertical ocellar sulcus
detailed.def: The frontal line that is a sulcus.

detailed.name: vesicula seminalis
detailed.def: The anatomical space that functions as storage of spermatozoa.

detailed.name: vestibulum
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is located dorsally of abdominal sternum 7 when the latter extends beyond the abdominal sternum 8.

detailed.name: villus
detailed.def: The area that is covered with dense setae and is located posterior to the metapleural spiracle.

detailed.name: visceral muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that is attached to the alimentary canal.

detailed.name: volsella
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the sclerites on the ventral part of the male genitalia that are not connected to the cupula via muscles.

detailed.name: volsellar plate
detailed.def: The area that is located on the parossiculus ventromedially of the cuspis.

detailed.name: volsellar ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that is located on the parossiculus, originates from the gonossiculo-parossicular articulation and extends towards the proximal margin of the parossiculus.

detailed.name: vulva
detailed.def: The anatomical space that corresponds to the opening of the vagina.

detailed.name: width
detailed.def: A 1-D extent quality which is equal to the distance from one side of an object to another side which is opposite.

detailed.name: width of 1st flagellomere
detailed.def: The width of the 1st flagellomere.

detailed.name: width of mesoscutellar-axillar complex
detailed.def: The maximum width of the mesoscutellar-axillar complex in dorsal view.

detailed.name: width of pedicel
detailed.def: The maximum width of the pedicel.

detailed.name: window under lateral bar
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is encircled by the lateral bar of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: wing
detailed.def: The appendage that is between the notum and the pectus and is connected to the body by the axillary sclerite muscles.

detailed.name: wing base
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the pteralia, humeral complex, tegula and axillary cord.

detailed.name: wing blade
detailed.def: The area that is located distally of the wing base.

detailed.name: wing cell
detailed.def: The wing membrane that is delimited by wing veins.

detailed.name: wing crease
detailed.def: The line along which the wing is creased.

detailed.name: wing membrane
detailed.def: The area that is not vein and not sclerotised.

detailed.name: wing region
detailed.def: The area that is delimited by flexion and fold lines on the wing.

detailed.name: wing vein
detailed.def: The area that is linear and sclerotised and acts as support for the wing membrane.

detailed.name: wing venation
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of abscissae.

detailed.name: propleural arm-procoxal muscle
detailed.def: The procoxal muscle that originates from the propleural arm.

detailed.name: prospinasternal apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme on the anteroventral margin of the mesopectus that serves as the site of origin of prospinasternal muscles.
